steps.detail: The arena looks empty until you turn back toward the door, which seals behind you.

steps.text: Phantom Ganon, first half: shoot him with the Bow three times as he rides out of the paintings.
steps.detail: Two Ganondorfs ride out of the six pictures on the walls. The fake turns and gallops back into its painting at the last moment; the real one keeps coming and blasts the middle of the arena for two hearts. Watch which of the two grows larger as it rides, and shoot that one. Stand in a corner rather than the middle: his lightning never reaches the corners.

steps.text: Second half: knock his energy orbs back with your sword until one hits him, then run in and slash. About thirteen hits finish him.
steps.detail: He floats free of the horse and throws slow purple orbs. Swing so the tip of the sword meets the orb and it flies back at him; he returns it, so keep rallying until he is too slow and it stuns him. Rarely he charges you for three hearts of damage; raise the shield or step aside.

steps.text: Take the Heart Container he leaves behind and step into the blue light.
steps.detail: Ganondorf's voice banishes the phantom before the light appears.

steps.text: Listen to Saria in the Chamber of Sages and take the Forest Medallion.
steps.detail: Saria is the Sage of Forest. You are set down in Kokiri Forest afterwards, next to the dead Great Deku Tree.

steps.text: In Kokiri Forest, watch the Deku Tree Sprout's story about where you came from.
steps.detail: He explains that you are Hylian, not Kokiri, which is why you grew up and your friends did not. Nothing to do but listen.

steps.text: Go back to the Temple of Time and talk to Sheik there to learn the Prelude of Light.
steps.detail: C-Up, C-Right, C-Up, C-Right, C-Left, C-Up. It warps you to the Temple of Time from anywhere. Sheik also points out that putting the Master Sword back in the pedestal turns you into a child again, which you will use later for the jobs only child Link can do.

steps.text: Go to the new Shooting Gallery in Kakariko Village, just past the House of Skulltula, and hit every target with the Bow for a bigger Quiver.
steps.detail: It works like the child version but with arrows instead of the Slingshot. Hit all the targets in one round and the Quiver goes up to 40 arrows. You can play again for Rupees, but the upgrade is only given once.

steps.text: Go into the House of Skulltula next door and talk to the freed man for the Piece of Heart given at 50 tokens.
steps.detail: Following this guide you have 54 tokens, so the 50-token reward is waiting. Each cursed man rewards you at 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and 100 tokens; the 100 prize is only an endless Rupee supply.

steps.text: Ride into Hyrule Field on Epona with the Fairy Bow equipped and go to the old guardhouse by the drawbridge, now the Ghost Shop.
steps.detail: You need both Epona and the Fairy Bow for this hunt: the Big Poes flee, so you shoot them from horseback.

steps.text: Talk to the Ghost Shop owner so he explains the Big Poe hunt.
steps.detail: He pays 50 Rupees per Big Poe. The prize for all ten is the fourth Empty Bottle.

steps.text: Poe 1: ride past the sign at the entrance to the broken bridge outside the ruins of Hyrule Castle Town.
steps.detail: Each Big Poe only appears when you cross an invisible ring on the ground. Ride through the spot, then turn and shoot.

steps.text: Shoot that Big Poe twice with the Fairy Bow from horseback, then ride up and talk to it to bottle it.
steps.detail: Two arrows bring it down. If you run out of bottles, sell what you are carrying at the Ghost Shop and come back.

steps.text: Poe 2: ride between the lone tree at the entrance to Lon Lon Ranch and the wall beside it.
Shoot that Big Poe twice with the Fairy Bow from horseback, then ride up and talk to it to bottle it.
steps.detail: Two arrows bring it down. If you run out of bottles, sell what you are carrying at the Ghost Shop and come back.

steps.text: Poe 3: in the north-west corner of Hyrule Field, ride over the small black bushes beside the stream.
steps.detail: The trigger sits on top of one of the bushes, so sweep across them until the Poe appears.

steps.text: Shoot that Big Poe twice with the Fairy Bow from horseback, then ride up and talk to it to bottle it.
steps.detail: Two arrows bring it down. If you run out of bottles, sell what you are carrying at the Ghost Shop and come back.

steps.text: Poe 4: between Lon Lon Ranch and the way to Gerudo Valley stands a lone tree; ride past its right side facing Hyrule Castle.
Shoot that Big Poe twice with the Fairy Bow from horseback, then ride up and talk to it to bottle it.
steps.detail: Two arrows bring it down. If you run out of bottles, sell what you are carrying at the Ghost Shop and come back.

steps.text: Poe 5: near the fork in the road before Gerudo Valley, ride the strip of ground between the road and the wall on the right.
steps.detail: This is the fiddliest of the ten. Face right and try to send the Poe through the gap so your arrows can reach it.

steps.text: Shoot that Big Poe twice with the Fairy Bow from horseback, then ride up and talk to it to bottle it.
steps.detail: Two arrows bring it down. If you run out of bottles, sell what you are carrying at the Ghost Shop and come back.

steps.text: Poe 6: in the south of Hyrule Field, between Lake Hylia and Kokiri Forest, ride through the patch of bushes among the trees.
Shoot that Big Poe twice with the Fairy Bow from horseback, then ride up and talk to it to bottle it.
steps.detail: Two arrows bring it down. If you run out of bottles, sell what you are carrying at the Ghost Shop and come back.

steps.text: Poe 7: in that same area, find the lone brown boulder and ride past the right side of the tree directly south of it, heading north.
Shoot that Big Poe twice with the Fairy Bow from horseback, then ride up and talk to it to bottle it.
steps.detail: Two arrows bring it down. If you run out of bottles, sell what you are carrying at the Ghost Shop and come back.

steps.text: Poe 8: on the road between Kokiri Forest and Lon Lon Ranch, stop at the silver boulder and stand in the fork of the Y-shaped road beside it.
Shoot that Big Poe twice with the Fairy Bow from horseback, then ride up and talk to it to bottle it.
steps.detail: Two arrows bring it down. If you run out of bottles, sell what you are carrying at the Ghost Shop and come back.

steps.text: Poe 9: wait in the corner of the V-shaped wall west of Lon Lon Ranch, either on top of it or riding alongside it.
Shoot that Big Poe twice with the Fairy Bow from horseback, then ride up and talk to it to bottle it.
steps.detail: Two arrows bring it down. If you run out of bottles, sell what you are carrying at the Ghost Shop and come back.

steps.text: Poe 10: by the entrance to Kakariko Village, wait on the overhang above the stream or ride through the pillar holding it up.
Shoot that Big Poe twice with the Fairy Bow from horseback, then ride up and talk to it to bottle it.
steps.detail: Two arrows bring it down. If you run out of bottles, sell what you are carrying at the Ghost Shop and come back.

steps.text: Return to the Ghost Shop and sell every Big Poe you are carrying.
steps.detail: You can only hold as many as you have empty bottles, so expect several round trips. Sold Poes stay sold.

steps.text: With all ten Big Poes sold, hear the owner out and take the fourth Empty Bottle.
Play the Prelude of Light to warp to the Temple of Time, put the Master Sword back in the pedestal to become a child, and walk out across Hyrule Field to Lake Hylia.
steps.detail: Skip this and the next two steps if you already taught the Scarecrow's Song to Bonooru as a child. This chapter uses that song three times, so the trip pays for itself.

steps.text: Stand in front of Bonooru, the lower of the two scarecrows between the Lakeside Laboratory and the Fishing Pond, and play any eight notes on your Ocarina to record the Scarecrow's Song.
steps.detail: Write the notes down: as an adult you have to play them back exactly. Four pairs of the same note is the easiest thing to remember.

steps.text: Play the Prelude of Light to warp back to the Temple of Time, pull the Master Sword to become an adult again, and return to Lake Hylia.
Stand in front of Bonooru as an adult and play the Scarecrow's Song back to him to switch it on.
steps.detail: From now on, wherever Navi flies out into thin air and turns green, this song summons Pierre the scarecrow as a Hookshot target.

steps.text: Get onto the roof of the Lakeside Laboratory: ride the magic bean plant growing in the soil outside it, or play the Scarecrow's Song from the dock and Hookshot to Pierre.
steps.detail: The lake is drained at this point in the game, so you cannot simply swim over.

steps.text: Climb the ladder on the laboratory roof and take the Piece of Heart on top.
Ride the bean plant or Hookshot to Pierre again to reach the Fishing Pond island, go inside and pay the owner 20 Rupees for a rod.
steps.detail: With the lake drained there is no way to walk to the pond.

steps.text: Climb onto the log near the middle of the pond, cast toward the centre and hook the biggest fish you can see.
steps.detail: The largest fish always sits in the middle. Do not thrash the line around: scared fish swim to the deepest water and stay there.

steps.text: Reel it in: hold A and hold the control stick down-left, and do not release either until the fish is landed.
steps.detail: It can take a while. If the fish gets away you have to leave the pond and come back to try again.

steps.text: Show the owner a fish of thirteen pounds or more to be given the Golden Scale.
steps.detail: The Golden Scale lets you dive to the bottom of the deepest water in the game, which the next two Pieces of Heart both need.

steps.text: Optional: land the Hylian Loach. Walk the shore until Link picks up the invisible Sinking Lure, cast it next to the giant fish on the bottom, press nothing so it sinks, and reel in when it bites.
steps.detail: The Loach only turns up on some visits; leave, play the Sun's Song and pay again until it is there. Most often the lure lies by the narrow stream. Showing the Loach to the owner is worth 50 Rupees and nothing else.

steps.text: Leave the pond, go into the Lakeside Laboratory and dive all the way to the bottom of the tank so the scientist notices.
steps.detail: Without the Golden Scale you cannot touch the floor of the tank.

steps.text: Climb out of the tank and talk to the scientist for a Piece of Heart.
Leave Lake Hylia into Hyrule Field and walk to the lone tree standing by itself northwest of Lon Lon Ranch.
steps.detail: The Stone of Agony rattles when you are standing on the right patch of grass.

steps.text: Drop a bomb beside the tree to blow the hidden grotto open, then drop into it.
Swim out over the deep water inside the grotto and dive to the bottom for a Piece of Heart.
steps.detail: The Golden Scale makes this a comfortable dive; with the Silver Scale you cannot get deep enough.

steps.text: Cross Hyrule Field to Kakariko Village, climb the steps at the back of the village and go through the gate onto the Death Mountain Trail.
Partway up the trail, at the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern, stand on the leaf of the magic bean plant in the soft soil and ride it up to the ledge above.
steps.detail: If you never planted a bean here as a child, the ledge can also be reached with a well-aimed jump from the Bomb Flower ledge, but the plant is the intended route.

steps.text: Jump off the plant onto the ledge and take the Piece of Heart.
Drop back down to the trail and go into Dodongo's Cavern.
From the main room on the ground floor, take the door on the right-hand (southeast) side into the narrow corridor full of Baby Dodongos.
Halfway along the corridor Navi flies up to an alcove in the left wall and turns green: play the Scarecrow's Song there to summon Pierre.
Hookshot to Pierre, then kill the Gold Skulltula in the alcove and take its token.
Leave Dodongo's Cavern and keep climbing the Death Mountain Trail to the entrance of Goron City.
If it is daytime, play the Sun's Song to bring on night, then go into Goron City and walk out along the rope bridges on the top floor.
steps.detail: This Gold Skulltula only comes out at night.

steps.text: Walk around to the back of the stone pillar in the middle of the top floor, kill the Gold Skulltula and take its token.
Drop down to the middle floor and find the Goron rolling around the ring.
steps.detail: The city is deserted apart from him and the shopkeeper: Ganondorf shut the rest of the Gorons inside the Fire Temple.

steps.text: Lay a bomb in the rolling Goron's path so he runs into it and stops.
steps.detail: Set it down a moment before he reaches you and step aside. He yells at you for sharing his name.

steps.text: Talk to him. He is Link, Darunia's son; sit through both of his stories and he hands over the Goron Tunic.
steps.detail: He will not give it up until you have heard both tales about Ganondorf and the dragon waiting in the Fire Temple.

steps.text: Equip the Goron Tunic on the equipment screen.
steps.detail: Without it, Death Mountain Crater and every room of the Fire Temple burn your hearts away steadily.

steps.text: Jump down to the bottom floor and go into Darunia's room at the back.
Pull the statue in Darunia's room away from the wall to uncover the secret passage to Death Mountain Crater, and go through it.
Follow the passage into Death Mountain Crater and Hookshot the wooden planks on the far side of the broken bridge to pull yourself across the gap.
Walk on along the bridge until Sheik drops down in front of you.
Listen to Sheik and learn the Bolero of Fire, the warp song that brings you straight to Death Mountain Crater.
Play the Prelude of Light, put the Master Sword back in the pedestal to become a child, and fill an empty bottle with Bugs.
steps.detail: Bugs crawl out of the clumps of grass around soft soil patches; the ones in Kakariko Village are the closest. You need one bottle free.

steps.text: Play the Bolero of Fire to warp into Death Mountain Crater as a child.
steps.detail: A child cannot wear a tunic, so the heat down here chips away at your hearts. Do the next three steps quickly and warp out.

steps.text: Pour the Bugs onto the patch of soft soil next to the Triforce warp platform.
Kill the Gold Skulltula that digs itself out of the soil and take its token.
Plant a Magic Bean in the same patch of soft soil.
steps.detail: If you are out of beans, buy another from the Bean Salesman at Zora's River. The sprout only becomes a plant you can ride once you are an adult again.

steps.text: Play the Prelude of Light, pull the Master Sword to become an adult, and play the Bolero of Fire to warp back to the crater.
Stand on the leaf of the grown bean plant beside the warp platform and ride it up to the top of the tall rock spire.
Step off onto the top of the spire and take the Piece of Heart.
steps.detail: There is another Piece of Heart in a cubby across the lava down here, usually picked up as a child by climbing down the wall; the bean plant passes it too if you still need it.

steps.text: Play the Bolero of Fire to drop back onto the warp platform, walk straight ahead and climb down the ladder to the ledge with the Fire Temple entrance.
Check your gear before going in: Goron Tunic worn, a full Bomb Bag, plenty of arrows and a bottled fairy if you have one. Then go through the temple door.
steps.detail: Bombs are used constantly in here. The Goron Shop back in the city sells them if you are short.

steps.text: Run up the stairs in the entrance room and take the door on the left. Darunia is waiting by the boss door and charges in after his speech, without the Boss Key.
steps.detail: Ignore the Fire Keese over the stairs. Darunia repeats what his son told you: Ganondorf woke a dragon in here and never found the legendary hammer.

steps.text: Jump across the small platforms on the left of Darunia's room to the ledge in the corner and step on the floor switch; the barred cell beside it opens.
Talk to the Goron in the cell to free him. He says something has to be done to the pillar in the ceiling of this room.
steps.detail: Every Goron you free gives a hint and then waddles out. This one matters much later, once you have the Hammer.

steps.text: Open the chest in the cell for a Small Key.
Go back into the entrance room and open the locked door on the other side of the stairs.
Hop along the small islands on the left-hand side of the big lava room to the ledge with a door in it, and go through.
steps.detail: With the Goron Tunic on, lava only chips your health slowly, so short dashes across it are fine. The Song of Time block on the ledge above is for the next few steps.

steps.text: Talk to the Goron in this cell to free him. He tells you that bombable walls sound different when you slash them.
Open the chest for a Small Key, then go back out to the lava room.
Stand at the edge of the platform outside that door, face the Song of Time block on the ledge above and play the Song of Time to sink it, then climb up and go through the door behind it.
steps.detail: Navi turns green when you stand on the right spot.

steps.text: Back into a corner of the tile room and hold up your shield while the Flying Tiles hurl themselves at you, then shoot the Like Like with arrows from across the room.
steps.detail: A Like Like that swallows you eats the Hylian Shield and the Goron Tunic, and you would have to buy them both again. Keep your distance.

steps.text: Kill the Gold Skulltula on the back wall of the tile room and take its token.
Drop back into the lava room, cross to the far side dodging the Fire Keese, and lay a bomb against the patch of wall shaped like a door.
steps.detail: Slash it first if you want to hear the hollow ring. Cutting across the lava is quicker than hopping every island.

steps.text: Talk to the Goron in the cell behind it to free him. He tells you that bombs can set off switches.
Open the chest for a Small Key.
Go back to the broken bridge in the middle of the lava room and open the locked door at its far end.
Hookshot the metal fencing hanging above the next room, climb on top of it and kill the two Keese on the horizontal strips.
steps.detail: You can also slide down the wooden ramp and climb up from below. If you slip into the lava, Hookshot the fence again straight away.

steps.text: Push the block on the right-hand side of the fencing over the edge so it lands on the flaming vent below.
Climb down, stand on top of the block and let the jet of fire lift it through the hole in the ceiling, then step off and open the locked door in the room above.
A Goron sits caged straight ahead, out of reach for now. Climb the ledge on your left and kill the Torch Slug, then climb the next ledge and kill its twin.
steps.detail: Torch Slugs are slow but relentless once they spot you. One jump attack each is enough.

steps.text: Jump across to the ledge with the crystal switch and the block, push the block off the ledge, then jump down after it and pull it until it sits squarely on the symbol marked on the floor.
Climb onto the block and up to the middle tier of the platform, then drop a bomb over the edge so it lands on the crystal switch below.
Climb to the top tier while the bomb ticks; when it blows the switch, the flames die long enough for you to climb the fence at the top and take the door.
steps.detail: Hitting the switch yourself from below does not buy enough time, which is the whole trick of this room.

steps.text: In the crescent-shaped boulder room, follow the outer wall to the right until you reach a floor switch, and step on it to open the cell beside it.
steps.detail: The boulders roll on set paths that stop and reverse for no reason. Everything worth having in this room sits in an alcove along the outer wall, under an overhang.

steps.text: Talk to the Goron in the cell to free him. He warns you about the Door Mimics ahead and says a bomb kills them.
Open the chest for a Small Key.
Carry on around the outer wall, past the face on the wall where you came in, to an alcove with a triangular overhang, and bomb the wall at the back of it.
steps.detail: Slash the wall first and it rings hollow; you can also hear the Skulltula scratching behind it.

steps.text: Kill the Gold Skulltula behind the hole and take its token.
Keep following the outer wall around two more corners to the next door and go in.
Talk to the Goron in the dark corridor to free him. He tells you to roll or slash if you catch fire.
Open the chest for a Small Key.
Carry on counter-clockwise along the outer wall to the locked door, open it and step carefully onto the narrow bridges in the small round room beyond.
steps.detail: Falling off these bridges drops you all the way back to the lava room by the entrance.

steps.text: Shoot the silver eye switch above with an arrow to open the door on the right.
Go through that door and open the big chest for the Dungeon Map, then come back and open the locked door in the round room.
Walk along the narrow strip of stone and jump onto the metal grating hanging from the ceiling. A wall of flame appears behind you, so keep moving forward.
steps.detail: If the wall catches you it knocks you down and then backs off a little, so it is survivable. Falling in the lava is not fatal either with the tunic on.

steps.text: Get past the two Red Bubbles that pop up at the jumps, either shielding them off or dropping into the lava to walk around them, then follow the grating to the far end, climb up and go through the door.
On the upper level of the boulder maze, jump to the platform straight ahead, kill the Torch Slug and lay a bomb on the crack in its floor to blow a hole open.
steps.detail: Navi points out that she can hear a Goron below.

steps.text: Climb down the grating and follow the long hallway round; it comes out in the Torch Slug room from earlier. Step on the switch there to open the caged Goron's cell.
steps.detail: That cell now links the two rooms, which is a big shortcut if you die later.

steps.text: Talk to the Goron to free him. He tells you to use bombs on the Flare Dancer you will meet later.
Open the chest for a Small Key, then climb back up the grating to the upper level of the maze.
Hop the narrow platforms in a U-shaped loop around to the platform with a floor switch, and step on it: a cell high on the far side of the room opens.
Work your way back across, Hookshot the Torch Slug on the small platform to stun it, jump over and kill it, then jump on to the open cell.
steps.detail: Stunning it first stops it knocking you down into the room, which would cost you the whole climb.

steps.text: Talk to the Goron in the cell to free him. He tells you to play your Ocarina where you cannot reach a place, then strolls off through thin air.
Open the chest for a Small Key.

Go back to the door you entered this level by, next to the first Torch Slug, face into the room and turn right: Navi flies to a platform above and turns green. Play the Scarecrow's Song and Hookshot to Pierre.
Turn around, Hookshot the small lift platform to ride it up, and go through the door at the top.
Round the corner of the secret room, climb the grating and take the Gold Skulltula's token.
Climb up to the next door and go through; walk in a little way, turn left and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the wall to pull its token in.

Step on the switch nearby to put out the flames around the chest on the ledge above, then Hookshot the target at the top of the steep ledge and run the last stretch along the edge to the chest: it holds a Gold Rupee worth 200.
steps.detail: You only just make it, and the prize is only rupees, so skip it if the run keeps failing.

steps.text: Jump into the middle of the pit and fall all the way down into the round room with the narrow bridges, go through its door into the flaming wall room, and run ahead of the fire to a high piece of grating halfway along.
steps.detail: If you skipped the secret rooms, go back through the door you entered the upper maze by instead. You want to end up opposite a ledge set into the outer wall.

steps.text: Jump from the high grating across to that ledge, open the locked door with a Small Key and follow the short hallway to the big C-shaped room.
Hug the outer wall and head right, killing the Fire Keese and letting the rolling boulder pass, then step around the flaming pillar just before the door on the right and go in.
steps.detail: Invisible walls of fire stand between the short pillars and only show when you are almost in them. Doors that stick out of the wall instead of being recessed are Door Mimics that fall on you.

steps.text: Open the big chest in the small side room for the Compass.
Go back out and work your way round to the left side of the room, past the giant pillar and the two spinning faces that spit fire.
steps.detail: The door you can see across the room on the way is a fake; ignore it.

steps.text: Pick your way slowly through the second field of invisible fire walls, keeping to the inner side, and open the locked door at the end with your last Small Key.
steps.detail: No boulders on this side, just one Fire Keese. Move a step at a time so a fire wall does not catch you.

steps.text: In the next room, stand where Navi turns green and play the Song of Time to bring a Time Block down from the ledge above as a shortcut to the upper level.
steps.detail: The Goron caged in this room stays caged until you have the Megaton Hammer. You come back here for him.

steps.text: Go through the next door: you come out in the C-shaped room again, on the far side of the fire walls. Kill the Fire Keese waiting there.
Work right and around the flaming pillar to the floor switch across from you, step on it to drop the wall of flame in front of the door on the left, and run for that door before the flames come back.
steps.detail: Walk the route to the door once before you press the switch: more invisible walls stand between it and the door, and the flames return fast.

steps.text: The door in the cubby is a Door Mimic: blow it up with a bomb and go through the real door hiding behind it.
steps.detail: Smash the jars by the cubby first if you need hearts before the mini-boss.

steps.text: Mini-boss: Flare Dancer. Target him while he spins and hit him with the Hookshot or a bomb to strip his flaming body off, then run the opposite way round the room, meet the black torso head-on and hit it with a jump attack.
steps.detail: Knock him out of his flames before the spin finishes or he sprays fire around the room: red flames sit still, blue ones creep after you. Keep slashing the torso until it runs, then repeat. He turns red to blue to green as he weakens.

steps.text: When he dies the flames on the middle platform go out: climb onto the platform and ride it up a level, then go through the door.
Climb the grating along the side of the hallway, drop a bomb over the edge onto the crystal switch below, then climb up and go through the door while the flames are out.
Cast Farore's Wind by the door to set a warp point before you try the run ahead.
steps.detail: Falling in this room means climbing back through the whole wing; the warp saves all of that. Skip this if you do not have the spell, it is optional.

steps.text: Go up the left side of the huge room all the way to the big chest, killing the Fire Keese on the way, then jump back down to the switch on the lower ledge.
steps.detail: Clearing the Keese first stops them knocking you off during the timed run.

steps.text: Step on the switch on that ledge to put out the flames around the big chest.
Run up the narrow platform to the big chest before the flames return and open it for the Megaton Hammer.
steps.detail: It may take several tries. If you fall, climb back up (or warp with Farore's Wind) and hit the switch again.

steps.text: Jump down to the lowest part of the room, pound the small platform marked with the Fire Temple symbol with the Hammer, drop through the hole, then smash the totem-like statue heads blocking the door and go through.
Run forward into the L-shaped room, turn around and kill the Keese, then smash the odd pillar in the middle with the Hammer: the floor collapses into giant steps leading down to a door.
Pick up one of the crates at the top of the room and carry it down the steps.
steps.detail: If you already smashed the crates, leave the room and come back to make them reappear.

steps.text: Put the crate down on the floor switch at the bottom to hold the door open, then go through.
Stand on the lone platform in the tiny room and smash it with the Hammer; you drop back into the crescent-shaped boulder room.
Climb onto the platform in front of you, pound the rusted switch on top of it with the Hammer, and go through the door it opens.
steps.detail: This is the door that has been shut since your first lap of this room.

steps.text: Play the Song of Time to shift the Time Block across the gap if you have not already; it uncovers a rusted switch on the far side.
Jump across and hit that rusted switch with the Hammer: the cell down below opens.
Jump down and talk to the Goron to free him. He tells you about a statue in the entrance room.
Open the chest down there for a Small Key.
Climb back up on the Time Block, go through the door into the C-shaped room, climb on top of the giant pillar that runs up through the floor and smash it with the Hammer.
steps.detail: This is the pillar in the ceiling the first Goron told you about.

steps.text: Fall through the hole it leaves: you land in Darunia's room, with the pillar now lying across the lava as a bridge to the boss door. Go out into the entrance room.
Go down the stairs to the statue at the bottom, stand to its left or right and pound it with the Hammer until it breaks apart.
Open the locked door the statue was hiding with your Small Key.
Kill the Fire Keese in the hallway with your sword, flip the Torch Slugs onto their backs with the Hammer and finish them off, then go through the door at the end.
Shield the Flying Tiles from a corner of the next room and kill the Like Like with arrows.
Kill the Gold Skulltula on the back wall of that room and take its token.
Take the door on the left. Flare Dancer again: smash the ground with the Hammer to knock him straight out of his flaming body, then chase the torso down and cut it up with your sword.
steps.detail: The Hammer shockwave strips his flames much faster than the Hookshot did, so this fight is short.

steps.text: Open the small chest that appears for Bombs.
Go through the door on the right and smash the rusted switch in the hallway with the Hammer.
Talk to the last freed Goron, who agrees it is time to go and face the dragon.
Open the big chest for the Boss Key.
Leave through the remaining door into the entrance room and go back into Darunia's room.
Smash the jar on the ledge to the right for a fairy and catch it in an empty bottle.
steps.detail: A bottled fairy revives you once in the boss fight, which is worth the detour here.

steps.text: Jump across the fallen pillar to the boss door and open it with the Boss Key.
Jump across the small platform onto the main hexagon in the middle of the boss room; the way back sinks into the lava behind you and Volvagia bursts out of the central pit.
Boss: Volvagia. Every time the dragon sticks its head out of a hole and pauses, run over, smash it with the Megaton Hammer and slash away with your sword while it is stunned.
steps.detail: Its three attacks: it flies to the ceiling and drops burning rocks (run away from the shadows, to the far side of the arena); it flies around breathing fire (stand right next to the hole it came out of, it cannot turn tightly, or shield and shoot it with arrows); and it leans over the edge before breathing fire, which is your cue to hammer its head. Late in the fight it fakes two holes and comes out of the third. If you fall in the lava you can climb back up the side.

steps.text: Take the Heart Container it leaves behind, then step into the blue warp.
Watch Darunia wake as the Sage of Fire and take the Fire Medallion from him.
steps.detail: The cloud over Death Mountain clears in the cutscene, and you are dropped back on the warp platform in Death Mountain Crater.

steps.text: From the warp platform head left and Hookshot the planks of the broken bridge to cross back, then follow the crater as far left as it goes, over a bridge, until you reach three red boulders.
Smash the two red boulders on the right with the Megaton Hammer to clear the cave entrance behind them.
steps.detail: Bombs do nothing to red boulders; only the Hammer breaks them.

steps.text: Go into the cave, stand on the Triforce symbol and play Zelda's Lullaby to summon the Great Fairy of Wisdom.
Take her gift: your Magic Meter is doubled in length.
Come out of the fountain, smash the red boulder on your right with the Hammer and go up through the crater entrance onto the Death Mountain Trail.
If it is daytime, play the Sun's Song to bring on night: both Gold Skulltulas up here only come out after dark.
Walk into the dip below the summit where boulders used to rain down as a child, and find the red boulder closest to the top.
steps.detail: With Volvagia dead nothing falls on you here any more.

steps.text: Smash that boulder with the Megaton Hammer, kill the Gold Skulltula hiding behind it and take its token.
Walk back down the trail to the entrance of Goron City and climb onto the ledge above Dodongo's Cavern next to it, where you threw a Bomb Flower down as a child.
Smash the red boulder on that ledge with the Hammer, kill the Gold Skulltula behind it and take the token.
Play the Prelude of Light to warp to the Temple of Time, walk out to Hyrule Field and head east to the entrance of Zora's River.
steps.detail: Zora's River is the east exit of Hyrule Field, where the river starts. Call Epona with Epona's Song to get there faster.

steps.text: Get onto the big plateau in the middle of Zora's River: ride the Magic Bean plant from the soft soil near the entrance and hop off onto the plateau as it passes.
steps.detail: The bean patch is where the Bean Salesman sat as a child. If you never planted a bean here, follow the path upriver until it narrows near Zora's Domain, turn right along the thin stream that runs back toward the entrance and climb the ladder on the ledge to reach the plateau.

steps.text: At night, Hookshot the Gold Skulltula high on the plateau's south wall and grab its token.
steps.detail: It only comes out at night; play the Sun's Song if it is daytime. Stand on the plateau, face the tall cliff wall on the south side and Z-target it.

steps.text: Continue toward Zora's Domain. Just after crossing the last stretch of water before the waterfall, climb onto the wooden fence and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula high on the wall for its token.
steps.detail: Night only. From the ground it is just out of Hookshot range, so stand on top of the fence first, then Z-target it.

steps.text: Stand on the platform in front of the waterfall and play Zelda's Lullaby, then jump through the opening into Zora's Domain.
Make it night with the Sun's Song, climb the stairs into King Zora's chamber and take the left exit out to the top of the frozen waterfall.
steps.detail: The whole domain is frozen and the Zoras are gone. King Zora is stuck in Red Ice; you will free him after the Ice Cavern.

steps.text: Walk to the edge of the frozen waterfall, turn left and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the wall beside it for its token.
steps.detail: It only appears at night. If you cannot see it, play the Sun's Song again.

steps.text: Go back to King Zora and walk past him through the tunnel behind his throne to Zora's Fountain.
steps.detail: The red shell around him is Red Ice. Nothing melts it yet; come back once you have Blue Fire.

steps.text: Walk out onto Jabu-Jabu's altar and drop down onto the floating ice floes below.
steps.detail: Jabu-Jabu is gone and the lake is full of ice. Octoroks shoot rocks from the water; ignore them and keep moving. If you fall in, climb back onto any floe that is not spinning.

steps.text: Hop across the floes to the right, wait for the small spinning floes to swing toward you, and jump onto the lone floe with the Piece of Heart.
steps.detail: The ice is slippery, so jump early and stop as soon as you land.

steps.text: Turn around and cross the three spinning floes in a row toward the cave mouth in the far wall, then take a running jump at the last still floe, grab its ledge and climb up into the Ice Cavern.
steps.detail: Keep running across the spinning floes; they only throw you off if you stand still on them.

steps.text: Follow the first winding hallway, slashing the stalagmites that block the path. Ignore the chunk of Red Ice on the way.
steps.detail: The pale stalactites on the ceiling drop as soon as you pass under them. Keep moving when you hear their icy crackle and they miss.

steps.text: In the big cave at the end, defeat all four Freezards so the icy bars on the far passage lift.
steps.detail: Freezards freeze you on contact (mash the stick to break free). Easiest: stand in the middle and cast Din's Fire. Otherwise Z-target one from a distance, wait until it finishes breathing ice, Hookshot it to stun it and slash it; back off after two. A Blade Trap circles the room and a second, invisible one appears, lunges and vanishes, so keep an eye on the floor.

steps.text: Go through the passage between the two chunks of Red Ice and along the second hallway. Watch the stalactite that drops just before the stalagmites.
steps.detail: The jars in this hallway hold Recovery Hearts.

steps.text: In the room with the giant spinning ice blade, follow the left wall from the entrance and grab the Silver Rupee behind the stalagmites.
steps.detail: Five Silver Rupees in this room open the bars on the ledge above. To avoid the blade, run counter-clockwise with it or crouch behind your shield (hold R without Z-targeting). Floating jars fly at you; raise your shield to block them.

steps.text: Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the wall above that first Silver Rupee and grab its token.
Collect the three Silver Rupees around the blade's center, crouching under the blade with R each time it comes around.
Climb the ledges by the wall and jump to the Silver Rupee floating in mid-air above the blade. The bars on the upper ledge open.
steps.detail: Line up the jump from the highest ledge; you can fall through the blade's path, so time it right after it passes.

steps.text: Go up through the opened bars into the next room and kill the lone Freezard on the floor plus any Ice Keese that come at you before you start climbing.
steps.detail: Ice Keese freeze you for a long time; shoot them with the Fairy Bow or Hookshot as they approach. Cleaning the room first makes the platforms safe.

steps.text: Climb onto the ice platform near the entrance and kill the Freezard at its far end, then grab the Recovery Hearts if you need them.
steps.detail: Z-target the Freezard from below and Hookshot up to it the moment it stops breathing ice.

steps.text: Jump along the small platforms to the left to reach the Blue Fire and scoop it into every empty bottle.
steps.detail: Navi explains that Blue Fire melts Red Ice. Empty your bottles first (drink or drop what is inside). One bottle is enough but you will refill several times, so fill as many as you have; there are four if you have followed the checklist.

steps.text: Kill the Freezard next to the Blue Fire, round the corner and pour Blue Fire on the Red Ice around the big chest, then open it for the Dungeon Map.
Refill any bottle you used with Blue Fire and go back down to the spinning blade room.
Melt the Red Ice blocking the left exit of the spinning blade room and go through the short hallway.
steps.detail: Both side exits of this room are sealed with Red Ice. Do the left one first; the right (west) one comes after the Compass.

steps.text: In the small cavern, run forward and cut through to the Blue Fire in the middle, kill the Keese perched on it and refill your bottles.
steps.detail: Keese cling to the walls and stalactites keep dropping here; they grow back shortly after falling, so keep moving.

steps.text: Melt the Red Ice on the chest on the right side of the cavern and open it for the Compass.
Melt the Red Ice on the left side of the cavern and take the Piece of Heart inside.
Hookshot the Gold Skulltula high up on the tall pillar in this cavern and grab its token.
Refill your bottles with Blue Fire and return to the spinning blade room.
Melt the Red Ice on the west exit, opposite the one you just used, and follow the S-shaped hallway to a blue cavern with a checkered ice floor.
Kill all the Ice Keese in the checkered-ice cavern before touching the block.
steps.detail: The floor is slippery; stop early when you run.

steps.text: Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the high wall of the cavern and grab its token.
Push the big ice block forward into the room, then right toward the north wall, climb it and melt the Red Ice in the alcove for the first Silver Rupee.
steps.detail: You need five Silver Rupees here to open the exit. If you run out of Blue Fire, there is a flame on the far side of the room; push the block over there first to reach it. If the block ends up somewhere useless, shove it into a pit and it reappears at its starting spot.

steps.text: Shove the block into a pit so it resets, then from its starting spot push it left, climb on top and hop onto the small pillar for the second Silver Rupee.
Keep pushing the block right across the room, climbing onto it to grab the remaining Silver Rupees as you go.
Climb up to the Blue Fire on the far side of the room and fill at least two bottles.
steps.detail: When Navi hovers over the floating red Rupees in front of the flame, play the Song of Time: blocks appear that let you grab the Rupees and walk straight up to the fire.

steps.text: With all five Silver Rupees collected, push the block right one last time so it sits under the newly opened hallway, climb on it and enter the hallway.
Work through the final hallway past its two Freezards, melt the wall of Red Ice at the end with a bottle of Blue Fire and go through the door.
steps.detail: Stun the Freezards with the Hookshot after they breathe, or just run past them.

steps.text: Defeat the White Wolfos in the small room and open the big chest that appears for the Iron Boots.
steps.detail: Mini-boss. It fights like a normal Wolfos with more health: Z-target it, keep your shield up, sidestep or backflip when it swipes, then slash its back or tail while it recovers. A jump attack after its miss ends it fast. It is the only White Wolfos in the game.

steps.text: Watch Sheik's scene and learn the Serenade of Water.
steps.detail: Sheik says the Zoras are trapped under the ice and only Princess Ruto was freed; she went ahead to the Water Temple. The song warps you to Lake Hylia.

steps.text: Equip the Iron Boots from the Equipment screen, walk into the pool to sink, open the underwater door and follow the tunnel.
steps.detail: An air timer appears once you are through; you can only stay under for a limited time until you have the Zora Tunic. The tunnel comes out in the pool on the ledge of the first big Freezard cave.

steps.text: Climb out of the water, switch back to the Kokiri Boots, drop into the Freezard cave and leave the Ice Cavern.
steps.detail: Make sure at least one bottle still holds Blue Fire; it is needed for King Zora. If not, go back and refill before leaving.

steps.text: Jump into the water, put on the Iron Boots to sink to the floor of Zora's Fountain and walk to the Piece of Heart lying on the bottom.
steps.detail: Your air timer runs while you are down there. If it gets low, switch back to the Kokiri Boots on the Equipment screen to float up, breathe and go again.

steps.text: Return to Zora's Domain and pour Blue Fire on the Red Ice around King Zora to free him.
steps.detail: Stand right in front of him and use the bottle of Blue Fire.

steps.text: Stand on the platform below King Zora and talk to him to receive the Zora Tunic.
steps.detail: With it on you can breathe underwater indefinitely. If a Like Like ever eats it, melt the Red Ice on the Zora Shop entrance on the lower level (a spare bottle of Blue Fire) and buy another for 300 Rupees.

steps.text: Go to Kakariko Village and talk to the Cucco Lady to receive the Pocket Egg.
steps.detail: You need Epona and a freed King Zora for this quest, and a Magic Bean planted in front of Dodongo's Cavern saves a lot of time at the end. Two legs are timed, so do not use warp songs during them.

steps.text: Play the Sun's Song until a new day dawns so the Pocket Egg hatches into the Pocket Cucco.
steps.detail: The egg hatches at sunrise. From daytime that takes two plays of the song; waiting in Hyrule Field also works.

steps.text: Enter the house at the bottom of the Kakariko stairs (across from the Skulltula House) and use the Pocket Cucco next to sleeping Talon to wake him.
steps.detail: Talon heads home to Lon Lon Ranch once he is awake.

steps.text: Go back to the Cucco Lady and trade the Pocket Cucco for Cojiro.
Make sure it is daytime, go into the Lost Woods and take the first left from the entrance. Show Cojiro to Grog, the pale man under the tree, for the Odd Mushroom.
steps.detail: A 3-minute timer starts here and warp songs are forbidden until you deliver it. Play the Sun's Song before talking to him: the Potion Shop you need is closed at night. If the timer runs out the mushroom spoils and Cojiro comes back; talk to Grog again.

steps.text: Run out of the Lost Woods to Hyrule Field, call Epona and gallop to Kakariko Village.
steps.detail: Fastest route: ride the Magic Bean plant in Grog's clearing up to the ledge and take the tunnel to the bridge into Hyrule Field. Otherwise run back through Kokiri Forest.

steps.text: Enter the Potion Shop (last building on the right toward Death Mountain), go out its back door on the left, drop down and climb the ramp to the little door of Granny's Potion Shop; give her the Odd Mushroom for the Odd Potion.
steps.detail: The Potion Shop only opens in daytime. Granny's shop is only reachable through that back yard.

steps.text: Return to Grog's spot in the Lost Woods (first left from the entrance) and give the Odd Potion to the Kokiri girl waiting there for the Poacher's Saw.
steps.detail: Not timed. LOCKOUT WARNING: if you still have not bought the Deku Nut capacity upgrade from the Business Scrub in the Lost Woods grotto, get it before handing over the potion. Once you own the Poacher's Saw that upgrade is gone forever on N64. She tells you Grog turned into a Stalfos and keeps the potion.

steps.text: Go to Gerudo Valley, jump the broken bridge on Epona at full gallop and give the Poacher's Saw to the carpenters' boss by the tent for the Broken Goron's Sword.
steps.detail: Not timed. Line Epona up straight on the bridge and hold a full-speed gallop; she clears the gap. Later, the Longshot also gets you across.

steps.text: Play the Bolero of Fire, climb out of Death Mountain Crater to the summit and show the Broken Goron's Sword to Biggoron for the Prescription.
steps.detail: Not timed. From the warp point follow the path up and Hookshot across the broken rope bridge to the crater exit. Biggoron is the giant Goron sitting on the mountain top just outside the crater. He has volcanic dust in his eyes and cannot see well.

steps.text: Go to Zora's Domain and show the Prescription to King Zora to receive the Eyeball Frog.
steps.detail: A 3-minute timer starts and warp songs are forbidden until the frog is delivered. Get ready before you talk to him: full hearts, bottles sorted, and know the route.

steps.text: Run out of Zora's Domain, swim down Zora's River keeping left until Hyrule Field, call Epona and gallop southwest to Lake Hylia, jumping the fences at its entrance.
steps.detail: The current carries you downriver; stay left and keep swimming. Epona's Song works anywhere in Hyrule Field.

steps.text: Enter the Lakeside Laboratory and give the Eyeball Frog to the scientist for the World's Finest Eye Drops.
steps.detail: If the timer ran out you are left with the Prescription again; go back to King Zora for another frog.

steps.text: Leave the lab, call Epona and gallop to Kakariko Village, run through to Death Mountain Trail and ride the Magic Bean plant at Dodongo's Cavern up the mountain.
steps.detail: A 4-minute timer started when you got the drops; this is the hardest run. No warp songs. Without the bean plant, run up the trail on foot.

steps.text: Cross the upper trail, shoot the Skullwalltulas on the climbing wall with the Fairy Bow, climb to the summit and give Biggoron the World's Finest Eye Drops for the Claim Check.
steps.detail: Expect to arrive with only seconds to spare. If the timer runs out the drops spoil and you get the Prescription back: return to King Zora and redo the last two runs.

steps.text: Stay at the summit and play the Sun's Song until three days pass (about six plays), then show Biggoron the Claim Check to receive Biggoron's Sword.
steps.detail: Each sunrise counts as a day. The sword does double the Master Sword's damage but is two-handed, so no shield while it is out. It is the unbreakable version of the Giant's Knife Medigoron sells in Goron City for 200 Rupees, which snaps after a few swings; do not bother buying that one.

steps.text: Play the Serenade of Water to warp to Lake Hylia.
steps.detail: You need the Iron Boots and the Zora Tunic from the Ice Cavern. The lake is still drained, so the ruins on the lakebed are exposed.

steps.text: Enter the Lakeside Laboratory on the west shore, put on the Iron Boots and sink to the bottom of the small pool inside.
steps.detail: The pool is the square of water in the lab floor. Keep the Zora Tunic on so you can stay under as long as you like.

steps.text: Roll into the wooden crate at the bottom of the lab pool, kill the Gold Skulltula that pops out with the Hookshot and grab its token.
steps.detail: Stay in the Iron Boots so you do not float off. Walk into the token or pull it in with the Hookshot.

steps.text: Leave the lab and follow the exposed ruins down the drained lakebed to its deepest point, then sink through the remaining pool with the Iron Boots to the temple's barred entrance.
steps.detail: The entrance is at the foot of the island with the lone tree and the Water Temple signpost. Wear the Zora Tunic so you can breathe underwater.

steps.text: Wearing the Iron Boots and Zora Tunic, stand right in front of the gate and Hookshot the crystal switch above the doorway to lift it. Enter the Water Temple.
Walk forward into the big central chamber (the main room). The water starts at its HIGH level.
steps.detail: You will come back here constantly. The main room has a central pillar, three floors (bottom, middle, top) and a passage on each side (north, east, south, west). Three Triforce symbols set the water to LOW, MIDDLE or HIGH. Every step tagged [Water LOW/MIDDLE/HIGH] tells you the level the main room must be at for that step.

steps.text: [Water HIGH] Put on the Iron Boots, jump in and sink to the bottom floor of the main room. Hookshot the Spikes patrolling the floor before they touch you.
steps.detail: Spikes are the rolling spiked balls; Z-target and Hookshot them from a distance. The Zora Tunic lets you breathe indefinitely.

steps.text: [Water HIGH] On the bottom floor, take the east passage between the two torches and follow the S-shaped corridor to the cutscene with adult Princess Ruto.
steps.detail: Ruto floats up the shaft after she finishes talking.

steps.text: [Water HIGH] Take off the Iron Boots, float all the way up the shaft where Ruto vanished and go through the door at the top.
Kill the four Spikes in the small room, then open the big chest that appears for the Dungeon Map.
steps.detail: Hookshot them from a distance, or throw a Deku Nut to stun all four at once and slash them.

steps.text: Go back out to the top of Ruto's shaft and play Zelda's Lullaby in front of the Triforce symbol on the wall. The water drops to LOW.
steps.detail: This is the first of the three water controls. Any Triforce symbol in the game means: play Zelda's Lullaby here.

steps.text: [Water LOW] Jump down the now-empty shaft to the floor where you met Ruto and light the two unlit torches beside the door there.
steps.detail: The centre torch is lit now that the water is gone. Shoot arrows through its flame at the two torches flanking the door, or cast Din's Fire between them.

steps.text: [Water LOW] Enter the door, kill the Shell Blades inside and open the chest that appears for a Small Key (1 key). Walk back out to the main room.
steps.detail: Z-target a Shell Blade and Hookshot or shoot it while its shell is open, or get close and cast Din's Fire to hit them all at once.

steps.text: [Water LOW] Back on the bottom floor of the main room, take the south passage (immediately to your left as you come out of the east passage) and bomb the cracked floor at the dead end.
[Water LOW] Drop into the hole, put on the Iron Boots, get past the Shell Blade on the bottom and surface on the far side.
steps.detail: Either Hookshot the Shell Blade or take the boots off and swim over it.

steps.text: Climb onto the small platform and step on the floor switch to raise the water in this room a little.
Climb up one level: the statue that was underwater now shows a Hookshot target. Hookshot across and kill the two Tektites.
steps.detail: It is easier to move past them first so you are not knocked back into the water while fighting.

steps.text: Walk up to the barred gate and do a Spin Attack to hit the crystal switch behind it; the gate opens. Grab the Gold Skulltula token inside.
steps.detail: On N64 the crystal switch sits beyond the bars, so charge a spin attack right in front of the gate (the 3DS version puts the switch in front). Take the goodies from the jars too.

steps.text: [Water LOW] Return to the main room: back through the switch room, down the hole and up the south passage.
[Water LOW] Take the west passage on the bottom floor. Stand on the platform and push the block ahead until it drops into a hole and locks underwater, then sink after it and climb up on the far side.
steps.detail: Iron Boots on to walk under, boots off to float up onto the far ledge.

steps.text: Slash the crystal switch near the entrance, jump onto the water pillar that shoots up and hop across to the far ledge. Run past the Tektite to the door.
steps.detail: If you fall into the pit, Hookshot the target to get back up.

steps.text: Spinning water room: put on the Iron Boots, jump in and settle on the body of the iron dragon statue in the corner opposite the door.
steps.detail: Without the boots the current spins you around the room. The dragon weaves in and out of the walls; land where its body is solid and stop moving.

steps.text: From the dragon's body, Hookshot the crystal switch in the dragon's mouth: the nearby door opens for a few seconds. Hookshot the target on the wall in the alcove and run through before it shuts.
In the alcove passage, take off the Iron Boots as you approach so you float over the two Shell Blades and rise into the small chamber. Climb up and open the chest for a Small Key (2 keys).
steps.detail: The Shell Blades are a pain to fight here; just float past them.

steps.text: Hit the crystal switch in the key chamber to reopen the door, swim back down and out to the spinning room's entrance door before it shuts, and go through it.
steps.detail: A Bomb beside the switch gives the most time; a sword hit also works if you leave immediately. Put the Iron Boots on for the crossing so the current does not carry you.

steps.text: Back in the water pillar room, kill the Tektite, Hookshot the target across (or shoot the crystal switch with an arrow to raise the pillar) and return to the main room.
steps.detail: At the block passage, wear the Iron Boots and Hookshot up onto the ledge you pushed the block from.

steps.text: [Water LOW] With 2 Small Keys, open the locked door at the base of the central pillar on the bottom floor of the main room (1 key left).
Inside the pillar, run forward, turn around and Hookshot the target on the underside of the platform above you. Climb up and play Zelda's Lullaby at the Triforce symbol: the water rises to MIDDLE.

[Water MIDDLE] Do not leave yet. Stand on one of the two raised platforms, put on the Iron Boots and step off between them: you land on the platform that rose with the water. Sink into the hole beneath it.
steps.detail: This hidden hole is the step most players miss. The cutscene of the water rising showed the lower platform lifting and uncovering it.

steps.text: Round the corner in the flooded basement and Hookshot the lone crystal switch from a distance: a gate opens and enemies drop down. Kill them one at a time while inching forward.
steps.detail: Keep the Iron Boots on and Z-target each one as it comes. Once all are dead, the gate on the far side opens.

steps.text: Take off the Iron Boots, float up through the opened gate and open the chest for a Small Key (2 keys). Go back up to the pillar's Triforce room and leave through its door onto the middle floor of the main room.
[Water MIDDLE] On the middle floor, enter the east passage (the one with two jars at its mouth) and follow it until you reach the floor spikes.
Hookshot onto the platform across from the floor spikes, then turn around and Hookshot the farthest target on the ceiling to ride all the way up.
Hit the crystal switch up here and open the chest before its timer runs out for the Compass.
steps.detail: Drop a Bomb beside the switch and run to the chest, or stand at the chest and shoot the switch with an arrow.

steps.text: [Water MIDDLE] Return to the main room. Drop down carefully so you do not land on the floor spikes.
[Water MIDDLE] Put on the Iron Boots, sink to the bottom floor and go through the east passage between the torches again. Boots off, float up Ruto's shaft to the cracked wall partway up and bomb it.
Open the small chest behind the cracked wall for a Small Key (3 keys), then return to the main room.
[Water MIDDLE] Go through the locked door on the west side of the main room's middle floor (2 keys left).
Walk up to the spot where the water pillar rises to lure the Tektite down from above, and kill it.
Stand on the water pillar spot and hit the crystal switch across the room with an arrow or a Bomb. Ride the pillar up and go through the door above.
You come out in a small alcove of the main room beside the third Triforce symbol. Play Zelda's Lullaby to raise the water to HIGH.
[Water HIGH] Enter the locked door on the west side of the top floor of the main room (1 key left).
steps.detail: If you have fewer than 2 keys here, one earlier chest was skipped: the Shell Blade room (LOW), the spinning dragon room (LOW), the basement under the pillar (MIDDLE) or the cracked wall in Ruto's shaft (MIDDLE).

steps.text: Waterfall room: kill the two Keese first, then jump down to the lowest platform directly below you.
steps.detail: The Gold Skulltula on the wall here is out of Hookshot range; you come back for it with the Longshot.

steps.text: Hookshot across to the platforms sliding down the waterfall and keep Hookshotting upward from platform to platform until you can reach the ledge by the far locked door. Enter it (0 keys left).
steps.detail: The platforms keep descending, so pick a high one and move quickly. Falling drops you back to the bottom of the room.

steps.text: Statue room: Hookshot the crystal switch in the centre to raise this room's water, then lure the Tektites to your starting platform and kill them.
steps.detail: Raising the water floats the statues up and reveals Hookshot targets on them. If you fall in while the water is low, put on the Iron Boots and Hookshot the switch to raise it again.

steps.text: With the room's water raised, Hookshot to the next platform clockwise.
Hit the switch to lower the water, Hookshot the target on the left side of the next platform and climb across the statue's head.
Raise the water again and Hookshot to the last platform.
Lower the water, climb on top of the statue's head, then raise the water once more to ride up to the top ledge.
Up top, kill the two Blue Tektites, then kill the Like Like across the spikes with a Spin Attack or Bombs. Hookshot the ceiling target to cross over and go through the door.
steps.detail: Break the jars for hearts and magic first: a mini-boss is next.

steps.text: Room of Illusions: walk across the shallow water to the far door, then turn around. Dark Link is waiting by the tree. Defeat him.
steps.detail: He mirrors your moves at first, blocks most Z-targeted slashes and gets more aggressive as the fight goes on. Easiest: cast Din's Fire repeatedly (it hits him every time), or hack away with the Biggoron's Sword if you have it. With the Master Sword, Z-target and keep tapping B: he blocks 3 or 4 times, then a hit lands. Never thrust at him while Z-targeting: he hops onto your blade and counters. Slashing without Z-targeting connects more often but leaves you open. Megaton Hammer jump attacks also work. The invisible walls around the room stop you at the edges.

steps.text: Go through the door that opens after the fight and open the big chest for the Longshot.
Stand next to the Time Block on the far side of the chest and play the Song of Time to make it vanish, then drop into the cavern below.
Raging water cavern: jump in and swim to the end of the first stretch, hugging the left wall to get past the first vortex.
steps.detail: A vortex sucks you down and restarts the room. Swimming slowly works better than the Iron Boots here because the sloped floor makes you slide; press B for a burst of speed when you need it.

steps.text: At the next corner, put on the Iron Boots, Longshot the Gold Skulltula on the wall and grab its token.
Take the Iron Boots off, round the corner hugging the right wall and swim past the two vortexes ahead along the right side to the ledge with two jars. Climb up.
steps.detail: Do not wear the boots on this stretch: you would slide into a vortex.

steps.text: Jump in from the corner of the jar ledge, wait until you are floating on the surface, then swim across to the small platform opposite (between you and the closed corridor) and climb up.
steps.detail: If the current worries you, inch across with the Iron Boots on and take them off to climb out.

steps.text: Shoot the golden eye switch on the wall across from you with the Fairy Bow: the doorway opens for a few seconds. Jump across and open the chest for a Small Key (1 key).
[Water HIGH] Drop down into the spinning dragon room from earlier and go back through the water pillar room and the block passage to the main room. Float up to the top floor.
steps.detail: Iron Boots on for the dragon room and the block passage, boots off to float up in the main room.

steps.text: [Water HIGH] On the top floor, go through the west door into the waterfall room again. Longshot the Gold Skulltula on the right-hand wall and grab its token, then return to the main room.

[Water HIGH] Put on the Iron Boots, sink to the bottom floor, go through the east passage between the torches, float up Ruto's shaft and play Zelda's Lullaby at the first Triforce: the water drops to LOW.
[Water LOW] Enter the central pillar through its bottom door, Longshot up to the platform and play Zelda's Lullaby at the second Triforce: the water rises to MIDDLE.
[Water MIDDLE] Before leaving the pillar, look straight up and Longshot the Gold Skulltula at the very top of the pillar's interior. Grab its token.
[Water MIDDLE] Exit the pillar onto the middle floor and face the south passage, which has a golden eye switch and an iron grating. Lure the Blue Tektites down and kill them first.
Shoot the eye switch with an arrow and immediately Longshot through the raised grating into the corridor before it drops.
steps.detail: Only the Longshot reaches far enough to get in before the grating closes; that is why this was impossible earlier.

steps.text: Walk down the corridor to the red block and pull it back until it locks in place. Turn around, go back down the corridor and Longshot up to the target to return to the main room.
[Water MIDDLE] Drop back down to the middle floor, shoot the eye switch again and Longshot through the grating a second time.
Now push the red block forward: an opening appears on the right. Run in and open the chest for the last Small Key (2 keys). Longshot up to the target and return to the main room.

[Water MIDDLE] Put on the Iron Boots, sink to the bottom floor and enter the north passage (the sandy area with a ditch and two Spikes). Sink through and float back up into a room where a spiked wall blocks the far door.
Turn around, climb onto the ledge behind you and Longshot the target on the other side of the room. Enter the locked door there (1 key left).
Rolling boulder room: cross the zig-zagging rushing water past the Blue Tektites and rolling boulders to the door on the far side.
steps.detail: Six Blue Tektites and two boulders patrol here. Safest: lure the Tektites over by shooting arrows or swimming out and back, and kill them first. Otherwise stay on the right side near the end and swim under them; if you drift toward a vortex, put on the Iron Boots.

steps.text: Kill the Stingers in the next room first.
steps.detail: They leap out of the water; Z-target and Longshot or slash them.

steps.text: Bomb both walls at the south end of the room to open two passages: together they form a U with a large block in the middle.
steps.detail: One wall is visibly cracked and the other looks slightly off as well. Place a Bomb against each.

steps.text: Push and pull the block out of the back room and into the water so it lands on the submerged floor switch. The water rises: climb up and go through the door.
steps.detail: This takes several trips back and forth around the U.

steps.text: Second water pillar room: lure and kill the Tektites, then hit the crystal switch and cross the water pillars to the far door before the timer ends (the same timer opens that door).
steps.detail: Shoot the Tektites with arrows from the ledge, or jump down and get close to the far side to draw them toward you.

steps.text: You are now in one of the upper alcoves of the boulder room. Inch to the edge, look right and Longshot the Gold Skulltula; grab its token.
Wait for a boulder to pass, put on the Iron Boots, jump into the water and walk toward the waterfall, sinking into the deeper channel.
Round the corner slowly and Longshot the Shell Blade waiting there. Take off the Iron Boots, float up and open the locked door with your last Small Key (0 keys).
Open the ornate chest for the Boss Key, then backtrack all the way to the main room.
steps.detail: Back through the boulder room and the north passage; use the Iron Boots to sink through the ditch and float up in the main room.

steps.text: [Water MIDDLE] Raise the water to HIGH: from the middle floor take the west door, hit the crystal switch and ride the water pillar up, and play Zelda's Lullaby at the third Triforce in the alcove.
[Water HIGH] On the top floor, Longshot the target on the dragon statue on the north side of the main room. Fill any empty bottles with the Fairies in the jars nearby, then enter the door.
Spike trap corridor: pick the left or right edge and run straight up the ramp without stopping or rolling until you reach the boss door at the top.
steps.detail: Slowing down makes you slide back to the bottom, usually into a spike trap. Wait until the lowest trap is on your side of the ramp before you start.

steps.text: Open the boss door and jump onto one of the platforms in the middle of the pool to fight Morpha.
steps.detail: Morpha is a nucleus that moves through the water and raises tentacles to grab you; listen for the sound and back away as one forms. When the nucleus travels up a tentacle, Z-target it and Longshot it out, then slash it, keeping open floor behind you so it does not bounce straight back into the water. Later it raises two, then three tentacles at once. If grabbed you get squeezed and thrown across the room. Fast method: stand in a corner, Longshot the nucleus, run around it so it sits between you and the corner, and keep slashing; it bounces off the walls and cannot escape.

steps.text: Grab the Heart Container, then step into the blue light to leave.
In the Chamber of Sages, receive the Water Medallion from Ruto.
Watch Sheik's scene on the island as the lake fills back up.
Stand just in front of the stone marker on the island and shoot the rising sun with an arrow. The Fire Arrows drop onto the small island nearby.
steps.detail: The marker tells you to shoot for the morning light. It is dawn automatically after the scene; if you miss the window, play the Sun's Song at night to bring back the morning and try again. Aim at the sun itself as it sits just above the horizon.

steps.text: Swim out to the small island where the Fire Arrows landed and pick them up.
Play the Sun's Song until it is night, then go back to the island above the Water Temple entrance and Longshot up onto the tree there.
steps.detail: Aim upward at an angle so you land on the branch rather than the trunk. The Gold Skulltula only appears at night.

steps.text: Walk along the branch and look at the top of the tree: Longshot the Gold Skulltula and grab its token.
As adult Link, walk into Kakariko Village from Hyrule Field after finishing the Water Temple; the village is in flames and a scene takes over.
steps.detail: Come in through the stairway gate from Hyrule Field, on foot or on Epona. You cannot warp here yet. Nothing you press during the scene matters.

steps.text: Watch Sheik face the shadow beast that bursts out of the village well; it knocks Link flat and escapes toward the Graveyard.
steps.detail: That is Bongo Bongo, the boss of the Shadow Temple, breaking the seal Impa put on it. There is nothing to fight and nothing to dodge here.

steps.text: When Link wakes up beside the well, listen to Sheik and take out the Ocarina to learn the Nocturne of Shadow.
steps.detail: The warp point is the Shadow Temple entrance up in the Graveyard. Do not go in yet: the temple is unplayable without the Lens of Truth, which sits at the Bottom of the Well and can only be reached as child Link.

steps.text: Climb the stairs on the far side of the village, beside the path to the Graveyard, and go into the Windmill.
steps.detail: The Windmill is the round stone building at the top of the village. Guru-Guru is inside, furiously cranking his music box.

steps.text: Talk to Guru-Guru and let him finish ranting about the kid who wrecked his windmill seven years ago.
steps.detail: That kid is you, later today. He will not play anything for you until the rant is over.

steps.text: Take out the Ocarina in front of Guru-Guru; he plays his tune and you learn the Song of Storms.
steps.detail: If you already learned it here right after getting the Hookshot, he just repeats himself, so tick this off and move on. Nothing else in this chapter works without the song.

steps.text: Play the Prelude of Light to warp to the Temple of Time.
steps.detail: Walking in through the Market works just as well. There is nothing else you need as an adult before going back in time.

steps.text: Walk up the main hall and through the open Door of Time into the pedestal chamber at the back.
steps.detail: The Door of Time stays open for the rest of the game, so this trip can be repeated whenever you want to change age.

steps.text: Put the Master Sword back into the Pedestal of Time to become child Link again.
steps.detail: Everything from here until you pull the sword again is done as child Link. Before you set off, fill up on Bombs, Deku Sticks and Deku Nuts: the Bazaar in the Market sells all three and you will want them inside the well.

steps.text: As child Link, leave the Temple of Time, go back down into the Market and take the path out of the northwest corner toward Hyrule Castle.
steps.detail: This whole visit exists for one Gold Skulltula. If you are not going for 100 percent, skip straight to Kakariko Village.

steps.text: Follow the road up the hill into the Hyrule Castle grounds.
steps.detail: Same walk as your first childhood trip to Zelda. Keep the Stone of Agony in mind: it matters at the top.

steps.text: Slip past the guard at the first gate while he is facing away from you.
steps.detail: Hug the wall on the side he has turned his back to. Being spotted only sends you back to the bottom of the castle road; nothing is lost but time.

steps.text: Work your way up the winding path, waiting behind the crates and bushes for each patrolling guard to turn his back before you run.
steps.detail: There are several guards spread along the slope. Move only while a guard is walking away from you, and stop the moment one turns.

steps.text: Climb the vines on the wall past the last guards to reach the closed castle gate.
steps.detail: This is the fenced yard where you woke Talon with the Cucco on your first visit, just short of the moat and the crawl hole to Zelda's courtyard.

steps.text: Stand next to the lone small tree in the corner beside the gate, where the Stone of Agony starts to rumble.
steps.detail: The tree is tucked against the wall in the corner of the yard. If the controller does not rumble, shuffle a step closer to the trunk.

steps.text: Play the Song of Storms beside the tree; a hole opens in the ground at your feet.
steps.detail: If nothing happens you are standing too far from the trunk. Move in and play it again.

steps.text: Drop down the hole into the grotto below.
Bomb the cracked wall on your left inside the grotto.
steps.detail: Set a Bomb against the crack and back off. The wall is directly to the left of where you land.

steps.text: Kill the Gold Skulltula behind the broken wall and pick up its token.
steps.detail: Slash it or shoot it with the Slingshot, then grab the token before it disappears.

steps.text: Step into the green warp where you landed to climb out of the grotto, then head back down to Hyrule Field.
steps.detail: You come out beside the tree again. There is nothing else to collect up here.

steps.text: Cross Hyrule Field to the northeast corner and go up the ramp into Zora's River.
steps.detail: This stretch is optional: it is worth two Pieces of Heart, and it needs the Song of Storms you just learned.

steps.text: Follow the river upstream over the ledges and stepping stones to the wide middle stretch where logs stick out of the water.
steps.detail: The logs sit roughly halfway between the entrance and the waterfall up to Zora's Domain, on the stretch with the lily pads.

steps.text: Jump onto the log closest to the bank and stand on the square mark painted on top of it.
Take out the Ocarina while standing on the mark; five Frogs pop up out of the river.
steps.detail: If nobody appears you are on the wrong log or off the mark. Step back onto the square and try again.

steps.text: Play the Song of Storms for the Frogs and take the Piece of Heart they hand over.
Play Zelda's Lullaby for the Frogs; one of them swells up and you get 50 Rupees.
steps.detail: Warp songs do nothing here. Stay on the square mark for all of these.

steps.text: Play Saria's Song for the Frogs; a second Frog grows.
Play Epona's Song for the Frogs; a third Frog grows.
Play the Sun's Song for the Frogs; a fourth Frog grows.
steps.detail: This also flips day to night or back. Play it again afterwards if you want daylight.

steps.text: Play the Song of Time for the Frogs; the fifth and last Frog grows.
With all five Frogs grown, take out the Ocarina again to start their button game.
steps.detail: You get fourteen prompts in a row. A wrong press or a slow one ends the round, and you start over by taking the Ocarina out again.

steps.text: Press the button of whichever Frog has the fly over its head, fourteen times running, then take the Piece of Heart.
steps.detail: N64 order: A, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down, A, C-Down, A, C-Down, C-Right, C-Left, A. On Switch Online the C buttons are the right stick. The order can vary, so watch the flies rather than trusting the list.

steps.text: Go back out to Hyrule Field and take the long stairway on the east side up into Kakariko Village.
steps.detail: From Zora's River, follow the water back out and cross the field to the southeast. The village entrance is the staircase cut into the cliff.

steps.text: Cross the village to the stairs on the far side, beside the path to the Graveyard, and go into the Windmill.
Stand right in front of Guru-Guru and play the Song of Storms; the Windmill spins out of control.
steps.detail: This is the exact moment the adult Guru-Guru complains about. It only ever has to be done once.

steps.text: Leave the Windmill and walk down to the stone well in the middle of the village; the water has drained away.
steps.detail: The windmill draws the well water. If the well is still full, you played the song in the wrong spot: go back and stand directly in front of Guru-Guru.

steps.text: Climb down into the empty well and go through the opening at the bottom to enter the Bottom of the Well.
steps.detail: Buy Bombs at the Kakariko Bazaar first if you are short: you need them for the boulders in the Basement and two piles of rubble in the Main Room.

steps.text: Crawl through the small hole directly ahead of you.
steps.detail: Child Link only. Adult Link cannot enter this dungeon at all, and in the future era the well is boarded over.

steps.text: Climb down the ladder on the other side to the corridor floor.
Kill the big Skulltula blocking the corridor: wait for it to spin around and expose its belly, then slash.
steps.detail: Its armored back deflects the sword. Z-target it and strike the moment the soft front faces you, or throw a Deku Nut to stun it first. The skeleton lying in the corner is only scenery.

steps.text: Walk straight into the wall at the end of the corridor; it is fake and you pass through it into the Main Room.
steps.detail: The whole dungeon is built out of fake walls and invisible holes. Until you have the Lens of Truth, only step where these steps tell you to.

steps.text: In the Main Room, walk forward to the shallow stream and turn right to follow it.
steps.detail: The Main Room is a doughnut: an outer ring of floor around a walled center room. The stream runs along that ring.

steps.text: Follow the stream all the way around the ring, keeping both feet in the water, until you reach the far side of the room.
steps.detail: The dry floor is riddled with invisible holes that drop you into the Basement. The water is always solid ground. If you do fall, skip ahead to the five Silver Rupees to climb back out, then come back to this point.

steps.text: Deal with the giant green Bubble that patrols the ring: stun it with the Boomerang and slash it, or stay on the water and let it float past.
steps.detail: It is the big flaming skull that circles the room. Hitting it head-on costs hearts; the Boomerang knocks it down so you can finish it safely.

steps.text: On the far side of the ring, stand on the Triforce symbol marked on the floor.
Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol; the water drains out of the dungeon.
steps.detail: This empties the pit back by the entrance and the grated pit on the west side, and you need both of them.

steps.text: Walk back around the ring the same way, along the strip where the stream used to run, to the spot where you came into the Main Room.
