steps.detail: The water is gone but that strip is still the safe ground. Wandering off it now is the easiest way to end up in the Basement.

steps.text: Drop into the small pit beside the Main Room entrance, now that the water has drained out of it.
Open the small chest at the bottom of the pit for Bombs.
Crawl through the small hole in the wall of the pit.
Kill the Skulltula hanging from the ceiling of the passage beyond.
steps.detail: Wait until its belly swings toward you before slashing, or take it down from a distance with the Slingshot.

steps.text: Climb the vines at the end of the passage.
Go through the door at the top of the vines into Dead Hand's room.
Beat Dead Hand: let one of the white hands grab you to summon it, then slash its head every time it leans down to bite.
steps.detail: Mash A and B to break out of a hand's grip. Dead Hand rises out of the floor and shuffles toward you; when it stretches its head down to bite, hit the head two or three times, then back away before it recovers. It burrows under and surfaces again, so repeat the cycle. A Deku Stick does double the Kokiri Sword's damage. Keep clear of the standing hands between rounds and you can win this without taking a hit.

steps.text: Open the big chest that appears for the Lens of Truth.
steps.detail: This is the item the Shadow Temple is impossible without. It burns magic while it is switched on, so turn it off between uses.

steps.text: Switch the Lens of Truth on here in Dead Hand's room; a hidden chest appears.
Open the hidden chest for a Huge Rupee worth 200.
Leave through the door and climb back down the vines.
Crawl back through the small hole and climb out of the pit into the Main Room.
steps.detail: You now have everything the main quest needs from this dungeon. Everything after this step is optional cleanup, so you can walk out now if you prefer.

steps.text: With the Lens of Truth on, cross into the walled center of the Main Room and find the small area with the X-shaped wooden poles.
steps.detail: The Lens draws fake walls as outlines and invisible holes as dark pits, so this is the first time you can see the room properly. Everything left here is the Dungeon Map, the Compass, three Gold Skulltulas and a handful of chests.

steps.text: Drop through the hole beside the X-shaped poles down into the Basement.
steps.detail: Other hidden holes in the ring lead down here too, but this one lands you closest to the Dungeon Map.

steps.text: In the Basement, take the branch on the far right, the one lit by two burning torches.
steps.detail: The Basement is a cavern of green poison water with four dead-end branches. Two of them hold nothing at all.

steps.text: Bomb the two boulders blocking the torch-lit passage.
steps.detail: Drop a Bomb at the first boulder, wait for the blast, then do the same at the second one a little further along.

steps.text: Play the Sun's Song to freeze the ReDead in the passage, then walk past it or cut it down.
steps.detail: A ReDead's scream roots you in place while it climbs onto your back. The Sun's Song paralyses it for several seconds, long enough to get past or kill it.

steps.text: Open the chest at the end of the passage for the Dungeon Map.
Walk back and take the branch where Navi turns green, then play the Sun's Song there to summon a fairy.
steps.detail: Only worth the walk if you are low on hearts. Catch the fairy in an empty bottle if you have a slot free.

steps.text: Go back to the main Basement cavern with the green poison water.
steps.detail: Do not wade into the water itself; it drains hearts while you stand in it.

steps.text: Freeze the lone ReDead in the cavern with the Sun's Song and kill it so it cannot grab you while you collect Rupees.
Collect the three Silver Rupees down by the wooden planks.
Climb the ladder up off the cavern floor.
Collect the fourth Silver Rupee on the ledge at the top of the ladder.
Climb the second ladder.
Collect the fifth and last Silver Rupee; the door up here unlocks.
Go through the opened door back into the Main Room; it shuts behind you.
steps.detail: If you fall into the Basement again later, all five Silver Rupees have to be collected again to reopen this door.

steps.text: With the Lens on, go into the walled center room and find the big chest sitting inside the fenced alcove.
steps.detail: The Lens shows an invisible pit running right across the mouth of the alcove. Do not try to jump it: the gap is too wide and you land in the Basement.

steps.text: Walk around the outside of the alcove and step through its fake side wall.
Open the big chest for the Compass.
steps.detail: Go back out through the same fake side wall, not across the pit.

steps.text: Go around the ring to the west side of the Main Room and drop into the pit covered with metal grating.
steps.detail: This pit was full of water until you played Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol.

steps.text: Open the small chest at the bottom of the grated pit.
Climb the wall at the far end of the pit.
Go through the door at the top of the wall into the Coffin Room.
Play the Sun's Song to freeze the Gibdo in the Coffin Room, then cut it down.
steps.detail: A Gibdo is a bandaged ReDead and hits much harder. Spiked traps also slide along the floor in here: wait for one to shoot past before you cross its lane.

steps.text: Light a Deku Stick on one of the burning torches in the room.
Light the torch beside the coffin in the southwest corner; that lid slides open.
steps.detail: Every coffin has its own torch. Din's Fire lights them without running back for a fresh stick. The other coffins only release Keese and another Gibdo, plus a few Rupees, so open them only if you want the Rupees.

steps.text: Take the Small Key out of the open southwest coffin.
Go back out the door, down the wall and out of the grated pit into the Main Room.
With the Lens on, follow the ring to the southwest corner of the Main Room and find the alcove hidden inside the wall.
steps.detail: The Dungeon Map marks both of these corner chests, which makes them easier to line up.

steps.text: Open the chest in the southwest alcove for a Small Key.
Carry on around the ring to the southeast corner and find the second hidden alcove with the Lens.
Open the chest in the southeast alcove for the third Small Key.
Go to the center room and unlock its left-hand door with a Small Key.
Hold your shield up as you walk into the left room so the flying pots smash against it.
steps.detail: The pots launch themselves at you from the sides of the room. Raise the shield with R and walk forward slowly rather than dodging.

steps.text: Kill the Deku Baba in the middle of the left room.
steps.detail: Wait for it to stretch upright, then slash. A rolling attack cuts it down too and leaves a Deku Stick behind.

steps.text: Kill the Gold Skulltula on the back wall of the left room and grab its token.
Leave the left room and unlock the right-hand door of the center room with a Small Key.
Stand in the doorway of the right room and pick off the swarm of Keese from there.
steps.detail: The Slingshot or the Boomerang clears them without letting any reach you. Walking straight in gets you swarmed over an invisible floor.

steps.text: Switch the Lens of Truth on to reveal the invisible walkway running across the right room.
Walk across the invisible walkway to the far side of the right room.
steps.detail: Keep the Lens on the whole way. Stepping off the strip drops you into the Basement and costs you the five Silver Rupees again.

steps.text: Kill the Gold Skulltula on the far wall and grab its token, then walk back across and leave the room.
Go around to the northeast corner of the Main Room and crawl through the small hole in the wall.
Unlock the door on the other side of the crawlspace with your last Small Key.
Equip the Hylian Shield before you go any further into the pit room.
steps.detail: Fire Keese burn a Deku Shield right off your back. The Hylian Shield cannot be burned.

steps.text: Switch the Lens of Truth on to see the invisible pits covering the floor of this room.
Let the Fire Keese dive into your raised shield, then slash each one as it drops.
steps.detail: Chasing them across invisible pits is how people fall in here. Stand still on solid ground, block, and counter.

steps.text: Throw a Bomb at the Beamos in the middle of the pit room.
steps.detail: A Beamos is the statue with the rotating red eye; only a Bomb stops it. Line the throw up with the Lens on so you do not step into a hole while aiming.

steps.text: Open the small chest in the corner of the pit room for a Deku Shield.
steps.detail: Handy if the Fire Keese burned yours. If you still have one, it is just a spare.

steps.text: Pick a path between the invisible pits to the door on the far side and go through it.
steps.detail: Lens on, move slowly, follow the solid strips. If you fall you land in the Basement and have to do the Silver Rupees again to get back up.

steps.text: Kill the Like Like in the small caged room: circle it, Z-target, stab, then back off before it reaches you.
steps.detail: If it swallows you it eats the Hylian Shield and your tunic. Kill it quickly and whatever it swallowed drops back out on the floor.

steps.text: Open the chest in the Like Like room for a replacement shield.
Kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall of the Like Like room and grab its token.
Go back across the pit room with the Lens on and crawl out through the hole into the Main Room.
In the northwest corner of the Main Room, throw a Bomb onto the rubble on the floor to uncover a chest.
Open the uncovered chest for Deku Nuts.
In the center room, kill the Skulltula guarding the cage on the right-hand side.
Open the chest inside that cage for Deku Nuts.
Back near the Main Room entrance, on the left, bomb the patch of rubble on the floor.
Drop through the hole the rubble was covering.
Open the chest down there for Bombchus.
steps.detail: Climb back out the way you dropped in. If you end up in the Basement instead, collect the five Silver Rupees again to reach the door back into the Main Room.

steps.text: Walk back around the ring to the Main Room entrance and step through the fake wall into the entry corridor.
Climb the ladder and crawl through the hole to leave the Bottom of the Well.
steps.detail: Dungeon done: Lens of Truth, Dungeon Map, Compass, three Small Keys spent and three Gold Skulltulas.

steps.text: Go to the Market as child Link.
steps.detail: Warp in with the Prelude of Light and walk out of the Temple of Time, or come in across the drawbridge from Hyrule Field.

steps.text: Play the Sun's Song in the Market square to turn it to night.
steps.detail: The Treasure Chest Shop only opens after dark. Play the song again afterwards if you want daylight back.

steps.text: Go into the Treasure Chest Shop, the building on the side of the Market that leads back out to Hyrule Field.
steps.detail: It is the one with the chest on its sign, near the drawbridge exit.

steps.text: Pay the man behind the counter 10 Rupees to start a round.
In the first room, switch the Lens of Truth on and look through both chests to see which one holds the Small Key.
steps.detail: Without the Lens each room is a coin flip and the game is close to unwinnable. With it on you cannot lose.

steps.text: Open only the chest that holds the key and unlock the door to the next room.
steps.detail: Opening the wrong chest ends the round and costs another 10 Rupees to start over.

steps.text: Repeat the Lens check and the key chest in each of the following rooms until you reach the last one.
Open the chest in the final room for a Piece of Heart.
steps.detail: That is the last of the child-era cleanup. Pull the Master Sword again and warp with the Nocturne of Shadow for the Shadow Temple.

steps.text: If you are still a child, go to the Temple of Time and pull the Master Sword from its pedestal to become an adult.
steps.detail: This chapter needs the Nocturne of Shadow, the Lens of Truth, Din's Fire, the Longshot, the Fairy Bow and the Iron Boots. Stock up on arrows and bombs, and carry a fairy or two for the boss.

steps.text: Play the Nocturne of Shadow to warp to the Graveyard, then walk down the steps into the pit with the ring of unlit torches.
steps.detail: The warp drops you on the raised ledge at the back of the Graveyard, right above the temple entrance.

steps.text: Stand on the round platform in the middle of the torch ring and cast Din's Fire to light every torch at once, then enter the Shadow Temple through the door that opens.
steps.detail: This is the only place in the game where Din's Fire is required. Make sure your Magic Meter isn't empty first.

steps.text: Longshot the target on the far side of the pit in the entry room, then walk straight into the wall ahead: it is fake.
steps.detail: A voice tells you the temple needs the "eye of truth". That is the Lens of Truth from the Bottom of the Well; without it, go back to the previous chapter.

steps.text: In the round room with the bird statue, turn left and scan the skull plates on the wall with the Lens of Truth: one is a fake wall hiding a corridor and a door. Go through it.
steps.detail: Leave the bird statue alone for now; you come back to it once you have the Hover Boots.

steps.text: Ignore the taunting voices in the next room and keep your hand on the right wall; follow it until you reach a door.
steps.detail: Several walls here are fake and the Lens of Truth reveals them, but sticking to the right wall gets you through without spending magic.

steps.text: Play the Sun's Song to freeze the ReDead, kill it, then shoot down the two Keese. Open the chest that appears for the Dungeon Map.
steps.detail: The ReDead's scream paralyzes you if it sees you; play the song before it turns to face you. The jars around the room hold hearts and arrows.

steps.text: Back in the voices room, follow the right wall again to the fake wall between two jars and walk through it.
steps.detail: Check it with the Lens of Truth if you are unsure. The floating jars on the left in the next half are just an illusion.

steps.text: Keep following the right wall through the second half of the room to the door into Dead Hand's room.
Defeat Dead Hand: let one of the hands grab you so it rises out of the ground, then slash its head when it leans down to bite.
steps.detail: Use the Lens of Truth to see where it is buried and move away from that spot before baiting it. When it drops its head, hit it with a jump attack; the Biggoron's Sword ends it in a few strikes. If it bites you, mash buttons to break free.

steps.text: Open the chest that appears for the Hover Boots.
Retrace your route through the voices rooms back to the round bird statue room near the entrance.
steps.detail: The fake walls you used are still open; go through them in reverse.

steps.text: Use the Lens of Truth on the skull torches around the room: only one of them holds a real skull. It is one of three spots and varies from game to game.
Grab the bird statue and push it around until its beak points at the real skull, then step away: the gate across the pit opens.
steps.detail: If nothing happens, check the skulls again with the Lens and turn the statue once more. It rotates freely, so retrying costs nothing.

steps.text: Equip the Hover Boots and run straight across the pit toward the open mouth; you just make it and grab the stone tongue. Climb up and follow the hallway.
steps.detail: The boots glide for about a second, so hit the edge at full speed. Falling only costs a little health and puts you back at the room entrance.

steps.text: In the four-way room, bomb the Beamos in the center. It respawns every time you re-enter the room.
steps.detail: After killing it, play the Song of Storms while facing the center to summon a healing fairy.

steps.text: Both side walls of this room are fake. Walk through the wall on the right.
Play the Sun's Song to stun the two Gibdos, kill them from behind, then open the chest for the Compass.
steps.detail: Gibdos also paralyze you with a scream; stun them before they get close.

steps.text: Go back to the Beamos room and walk through the fake wall on the opposite (left) side into the room with the giant spinning scythe statue.
Grab the two Silver Rupees in the middle of the room and the one in the alcove on each side, ducking (hold R) or rolling under the blades.
steps.detail: The statue in the center swings two scythes like the ice blade in the Ice Cavern; move with its rhythm, not against it.

steps.text: Longshot onto the stack of logs and jump off it toward the last Silver Rupee hanging in the air. The bars on the cell nearby lift.
Open the chest in the cell for a Small Key, then go back to the Beamos room.
steps.detail: Later in the dungeon a shortcut into this room opens from the boat room; if you die, you can come back that way.

steps.text: Bomb the one remaining solid wall of the Beamos room (straight ahead from where you first entered) to uncover a locked door, and open it with your Small Key.
steps.detail: The Dungeon Map shows the room extending that way, so the wall is the giveaway. Bomb the Beamos again first if it bothers you.

steps.text: Walk slowly down the S-shaped ramp and Longshot the three Skulltulas that drop from the ceiling before you bump into them.
At the bottom, jump down, run under the first guillotine right after it lifts, kill the Skulltula, and run under the second guillotine.
Round the corner. A Wallmaster lurks here: kill it or just keep moving.
steps.detail: A shadow on the floor appears before it falls. If it grabs you, you are dumped back at the start of the cavern.

steps.text: Jump from platform to platform under the guillotines, timing each jump right after a blade rises. Don't use the Hover Boots here: they slide you into the next blade.
steps.detail: On the third platform a Red Bubble pops out of nowhere; hold up your shield and it bounces off. Then jump to the last platform.

steps.text: Kill the Stalfos that appears on the last platform: stab forward repeatedly so it backs up and falls into the pit.
steps.detail: Play the Song of Storms afterwards for a fairy if you need health.

steps.text: Before dropping down, turn left and use the Lens of Truth to see a line of invisible platforms. Hop along them, following the outer wall, to a door.
steps.detail: Use the Hover Boots for the longer gaps and keep the Lens on while you check each edge. It drains magic, so refill with a green potion or a jar if it runs low.

steps.text: Hold the Lens of Truth to see the invisible spinning scythe inside the circle on the floor. Work your way around the room and kill the Keese on the walls.
steps.detail: Arrows or the Longshot get the Keese without stepping into the blades.

steps.text: Kill the Like Like on the far side of the room. Once every enemy is dead, the bars in the wall open.
steps.detail: Hit it from a distance with arrows or the Longshot so it can't swallow your shield or tunic.

steps.text: Open the two chests behind the bars: one is invisible (Lens of Truth) and holds Arrows; the other gives a Hylian Shield if the Like Like ate yours, otherwise a Blue Rupee.
Kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall behind the bars and grab its token.
Cross back over the invisible platforms to the Stalfos platform and kill the Stalfos again.
Look toward the other side for a platform that rises and falls; wait until it drops to its lowest point, then jump onto it.
steps.detail: Hover Boots can also get you there but slide easily, so a plain jump is safer.

steps.text: When the platform is at its highest, jump down to the lower area on the right side and follow the narrow bridge to a Beamos and two circling Blade Traps.
Grab the two Silver Rupees at the start of this area: one next to the ledge and one against the wall.
Grab the two Silver Rupees between the circling Blade Traps, then bomb the Beamos and take the one underneath it. The barred door opens.
steps.detail: Wait for both traps to swing away before stepping in. The Beamos rebuilds itself if you leave and return.

steps.text: In the room with the falling spiked platforms, read the sign (it wants a "stone umbrella"), then use the Lens of Truth to find a stone block hidden in an alcove in the wall.
steps.detail: Never step under a spiked platform: getting crushed restarts the room, and you cannot outrun them.

steps.text: Pull the block out and push it under the traps until it sits on the mark on the floor, right between the two spikes. It now holds the traps off the ground so you can pass.
Open the chest in the side alcove for Arrows.
In the alcove on the left side, behind the fence, kill the Gold Skulltula and pull its token to you with the Longshot.
Run to the far end of the room and pull the block all the way to the edge, then climb onto it and hop onto the top of the spiked platform.
From the top of the spikes, reach the upper ledge: open the chest behind the gate for rupees and step on the floor switch to make a chest appear on the far side.
Cross over on top of the other spiked platform to the new chest and open it for a Small Key, then return to the big cavern.

In the middle of the cavern, follow the strip of land with a single guillotine to its dead end. Use the Lens of Truth to see two invisible platforms (one moves back and forth) and cross them to the locked door. Open it with a Small Key.
Hold the Lens of Truth to see the three patches of invisible spikes on the floor, then play the Sun's Song to stun the two ReDeads and kill them. Open the chest that appears for five rupees.
Grab the Silver Rupee in the middle of the room, then Longshot the targets right above the two Silver Rupees against the walls to snag them.

The last two Silver Rupees float in the corner: the Lens shows an invisible platform under one. Longshot the invisible target to reach it, then use the Hover Boots to float over to the final rupee. The door opens.
Go through the door that opened, at floor level, into the room with the giant flaming skull. Shoot the four Keese with the Bow: the two above the entrance turn into Fire Keese at the blue torches.
steps.detail: Climb either set of ledges to reach the remaining Keese.

steps.text: From the ledge, throw Bomb Flowers into the giant skull until one lands inside; it blows up and a Small Key pops out. Jump down and pick up the Small Key.
Turn around: a Gold Skulltula was hiding behind where the skull stood. Kill it and take its token.
Return to the invisible spike room.
Use the Lens of Truth to find a Longshot target on the ceiling; Longshot up to the upper ledge and open the locked door there with a Small Key.
In the corridor of spike traps and fans, move while the fans are off (or wear the Iron Boots). Past the first corner, inch forward to make the Skulltula drop and kill it with the Longshot.
At the pit around the next corner, put on the Iron Boots and Longshot the wooden beam across the gap.
steps.detail: Or wait for the fan to stop and cross with the Hover Boots.

steps.text: Drop into the wind room: a bridge down the middle and fans on opposite walls. Walk across in the Iron Boots so the wind can't push you off.
Shoot the eye switch above the door on the far wall with an arrow the moment it opens (block its fireballs with your shield), then enter that door.
steps.detail: The reference calls this room optional; do it for 100%.

steps.text: Play the Sun's Song to stun the two ReDeads and kill them, then use the Lens of Truth to reveal the invisible chest and open it for Arrows.
steps.detail: The picture on the wall hints at the fake wall in the wind room. Playing the Sun's Song in the center of this room also calls a fairy.

steps.text: Back in the wind room, find the fake wall with the Lens of Truth in the side lane nearest the door. Wait for the fan to stop, equip the Hover Boots in front of the gap, and when it blows at full force run with the wind to the far side. Enter the door.
steps.detail: Resist the wind a little at first so it is at full strength when you commit; it carries you over the drop.

steps.text: In the dark Gibdo room, play the Sun's Song, kill the Gibdos, and open the small chest that appears for Bombs.
Bomb the dirt mound with the red crack in the corner, then use the Lens of Truth to reveal an invisible chest there. Open it for a Small Key and go through the locked door.
steps.detail: The Dungeon Map marks this chest even though nothing shows after the blast.

steps.text: In the big boat room, turn left and pull the huge stone block back, then push and pull it along the track until it clicks into the slot beside the ladder.
steps.detail: This also opens a shortcut from the scythe room near the temple entrance, so a death from here on costs much less backtracking.

steps.text: Climb the ladder onto the boat and look back toward the ledge above where the block used to be: Navi flies there and turns green. Play the Scarecrow's Song and Longshot to Pierre.
steps.detail: This needs the Scarecrow's Song (taught to Bonooru at Lake Hylia as a child and again as an adult).

steps.text: Kill the Gold Skulltula on that ledge, grab its token and jump back down to the boat.
On the boat, stand on the Triforce mark and play Zelda's Lullaby to set off.
Fight off the two Stalfos that board one after the other, or just keep your shield up until the ride ends.
steps.detail: Z-target one and the other mostly leaves you alone. Stab forward repeatedly; they drop their guard when you press them. You don't have to kill them.

steps.text: When the boat hits the wall at the end, jump off to the platform on the LEFT before it drops into the abyss, then enter the door on your right.
steps.detail: If you go down with the boat, you fall and have to ride it again from the dock.

steps.text: This maze is full of invisible walls, with a door in each corner and two Floormasters in the middle. Turn on the Lens of Truth and work clockwise, starting with the south door.
steps.detail: The Floormasters come back every time you re-enter; kill them or slip past.

steps.text: Hold the Lens of Truth: an invisible Floormaster waits inside. Kill the big hand, then Z-target and stab the small ones. Open the chest that appears for a Small Key.
steps.detail: You can't spin attack and hold the Lens at the same time, so stick to normal stabs.

steps.text: Back in the maze, go clockwise to the west door. In the room with three spinning skulls, kill the Gold Skulltula hiding behind the skulls and take its token.
steps.detail: Bomb the skulls if you want the magic jars, hearts, arrows and rupees they hold.

steps.text: Return to the maze and take the last door, to the north. Burn the two wooden spike walls closing in on you with Din's Fire (Fire Arrows don't work on them).
Kill the ReDead on each side of the room, then open the ornate chest for the Boss Key.
Go back to the ledge where you left the boat. Across the abyss, shoot the Bomb Flowers beside the tall pillar with an arrow so the pillar topples and bridges the gap.
steps.detail: Play the Song of Time at the base of the broken pillar for recovery hearts on the right; the Scarecrow's Song there puts Pierre on the high platform with more hearts.

steps.text: Cross the fallen pillar and open the locked door with your last Small Key.
steps.detail: You should have exactly one Small Key here; if you have none, you missed one earlier.

steps.text: Use the Lens of Truth to see the oddly shaped invisible pillars, and hover across them with the Hover Boots from a running start; either side works. Open the boss door and drop down the pit.
Defeat Bongo Bongo: shoot both hands with arrows to stun them, then use the Lens of Truth to see its body and shoot its eye as it charges. Slash it while it is down.
steps.detail: The drum floats in poison; if you get knocked off, climb back up fast. Leave the Hover Boots off, they make you slide. Stand back so both hands are in view, Z-target one and shoot it, then shoot the other when it returns to its resting spot (or stab a hand right after it slams the floor). Duck with R against the swipes and roll away from the slams. With both hands stunned, hold the Lens: it rushes you with its eye open, so hit the eye with an arrow (the Longshot or a sword strike also work) and then lay into it with the sword. The Biggoron's Sword ends the fight in a couple of rounds. Bring one or two fairies.

steps.text: Take the Heart Container and step into the blue light.
Watch Impa's scene in the Chamber of Sages and receive the Shadow Medallion.
steps.detail: Only the Spirit Medallion remains.

steps.text: Before you set out, make sure you are an adult and carrying the Longshot, Fairy Bow, Hover Boots, Lens of Truth, Din's Fire, Megaton Hammer, bombs and a Magic Bean.
steps.detail: This chapter swaps between child and adult twice, so keep the Ocarina songs handy too: Prelude of Light, Requiem of Spirit, Sun's Song, Song of Time and Song of Storms all get used. Fill your bottles and buy arrows and bombs in Castle Town first.

steps.text: Ride west across Hyrule Field to the canyon entrance of Gerudo Valley, in the far west of the map.
steps.detail: Epona cuts the trip to about a minute; on foot leave by the bridge outside Hyrule Castle Town and keep heading west past the boulder-strewn hills.

steps.text: Talk to the carpenters' boss standing by the tent on the near side of the ravine.
steps.detail: He explains the Gerudo smashed the bridge and locked up his four workers. He will not rebuild it until you free them, and you need his goodwill to pass through the fortress.

steps.text: Play the Sun's Song to bring on night, then Longshot the Gold Skulltula clinging to the rock wall directly behind the carpenters' tent.
steps.detail: Stand behind the tent and look up at the cliff face. Follow the rattling sound if you cannot spot it.

steps.text: Cross the ravine: Longshot the wooden target post on the far ledge, or gallop straight across the gap on Epona.
steps.detail: The broken planks dangling under the gap are also valid Longshot targets. If you fall you land by the river below and can climb the vines back up to the near side.

steps.text: On the far side, turn left to the stone archway and Longshot the Gold Skulltula near the top of one of its legs.
steps.detail: Still needs to be night. The arch sticks out of the rock face on the south side of the path.

steps.text: Follow the path west and up out of the valley into Gerudo's Fortress; a short scene pans over the camp.
steps.detail: Guards patrol every terrace. The moment one of them sees you, she hauls you off to a cell.

steps.text: Walk into the open and let the nearest guard spot you so she throws you in the prison cell.
steps.detail: This is the quickest way in and she takes nothing from you. If you would rather sneak, you can, but every direction below is written from the cell.

steps.text: In the cell, aim the Longshot at the wooden beam across the top of the window and pull yourself out onto the ledge.
steps.detail: Getting caught again later always dumps you back in this same cell, so this escape works every time.

steps.text: From the ledge, shoot the guard patrolling below with an arrow to stun her, then drop down.
steps.detail: A Longshot bolt stuns her just as well. You can also simply wait until she walks to the far end of her route.

steps.text: Go through the door at the left end of the walkway, at ground level.
steps.detail: It is the nearest doorway to where you landed, tucked under the ledge you escaped onto.

steps.text: Round the corner, talk to the carpenter Ichiro through the bars, then beat the Gerudo Thief who interrupts for her Small Key.
steps.detail: Block her swipes with your shield and answer with Z-targeted jump attacks. When she crouches and glows she is winding up a leaping strike that goes straight through your guard, so roll away from that one.

steps.text: Unlock Ichiro's cell with the Small Key and let him out. One carpenter free, three to go.
steps.detail: Each carpenter needs his own key, dropped by the thief guarding him.

steps.text: Leave by the opening at the far end of the room, step into the door just to your right outside, then turn right at the first chance inside and walk out of the next opening.
steps.detail: That door is the hub room joining most of the fortress. Going forward through it instead runs you into a line of guards; arrows stun them one at a time if you want to clear the place out.

steps.text: Outside, target around the corner, wait for the guard to turn her back, shoot her with an arrow, then climb the small ledge and enter the doorway.
steps.detail: Inch out only far enough to get the lock-on; if she turns around before you shoot, back off and wait for her next pass.

steps.text: Walk up to the cell and beat the Gerudo Thief who blocks it for her Small Key.
steps.detail: Same fight as the first: shield, jump attack, and give her room when she charges.

steps.text: Unlock the cell and free Jiro, the second carpenter.
steps.detail: Two down, two to go.

steps.text: Go out the opening at the far end of Jiro's room, then climb down the vines on the wall outside to the level below.
steps.detail: Ignore the door right beside you at the top of the vines; you come back for it in a moment.

steps.text: Enter the only door on this lower level, talk to the carpenter through the bars and beat the Gerudo Thief for her Small Key.
steps.detail: If she is wearing you down, Nayru's Love or a bottled fairy carries you through, but a shield and patience are enough.

steps.text: Unlock the cell and free Sabooro, the third carpenter.
steps.detail: One left. Leave the way you came in rather than by the other exit.

steps.text: Go back outside, climb the vines up again and take the door on the left.
steps.detail: This is the door you skipped on the way down.

steps.text: From the high ledge inside, shoot the two guards patrolling the floor below with arrows, then follow the walkway to the end and go out the opening.
steps.detail: They cannot see you up on the ledge. The Hover Boots carry you across the gap instead if you would rather not fight.

steps.text: Step inside and shoot the guard with an arrow from behind the crate as soon as she shows herself.
steps.detail: Stay behind the crate until she steps into view or she spots you first.

steps.text: Round the corner, talk to Shiro and beat the last Gerudo Thief for her Small Key.
steps.detail: Shiro passes on a rumour he overheard about the desert once he is out.

steps.text: Unlock the cell and free Shiro, the fourth carpenter.
steps.detail: All four are out; the carpenters' boss will rebuild the bridge back in Gerudo Valley.

steps.text: Step outside and watch the scene: the fortress leader hands you the Gerudo Membership Card.
steps.detail: The guards now leave you alone, the desert gate will open for you and the Gerudo Training Ground is unlocked. That mini-dungeon is covered in the last chapter, once you own every item.

steps.text: Play the Sun's Song to make it night, then work your way back up to the top terrace of the fortress through the guard hub room.
steps.detail: Same route as before: in through the hub, right at the first turn, out the opening, up past the cell rooms and out onto the high walkway.

steps.text: Climb onto the small ledge outside, follow it to its end, jump across onto the roof on your right, then go around the bend and climb the vines to the highest roof.
steps.detail: This is the ledge you deliberately skipped while freeing Shiro. If you slip off you land on a lower terrace; walk back around and climb again.

steps.text: Follow the highest roof to its far end, look down at the back wall and Longshot the Gold Skulltula on it.
steps.detail: It only appears at night. Stand at the very edge so the Longshot reticle turns on the token.

steps.text: From the edge of that roof, Longshot across the gap to the platform holding the large chest.
steps.detail: If your Longshot cannot reach, play the Scarecrow's Song at the edge to make Pierre appear on the far side and hookshot to him instead.

steps.text: Open the large chest for a Piece of Heart.
steps.detail: Drop straight down into the fortress afterwards; the fall is harmless.

steps.text: Back on the ground, play the Sun's Song to bring back daylight, then play Epona's Song to call Epona.
steps.detail: Epona comes when called inside the fortress grounds. You must have won her from Ingo at Lon Lon Ranch; without her the archery game cannot be played at all.

steps.text: Ride Epona to the fenced range at the back of the fortress and talk to the Gerudo in white from the saddle to start the Horseback Archery game.
steps.detail: You have to be mounted when you speak to her or she will not offer the game. It costs 20 Rupees a run.

steps.text: Score 1000 points or more on the range to win a Piece of Heart.
steps.detail: Epona runs on a fixed track, so only your aim matters. Break every clay pot on the way out, 100 points each, then work the big targets on the return leg: a bullseye is 100, an outer ring 60. Empty your quiver before the run ends.

steps.text: Talk to her and run the range again, this time scoring 1500 or more, for the Biggest Quiver.
steps.detail: The Piece of Heart is always handed out first, even on a 1500-point run, so you need at least two clean runs. The Biggest Quiver holds 50 arrows.

steps.text: Get off Epona, play the Sun's Song for night, then Longshot the Gold Skulltula sitting on the lone big target at the far end of the range.
steps.detail: It is the target standing by itself away from the wall, at the very back of the archery field.

steps.text: Head to the northwest corner of the fortress, climb the ladder beside the tall gate and talk to the Gerudo in white at the top.
steps.detail: She warns you about the two trials waiting in the desert, then claps to open the gate. She only does this once you hold the Gerudo Membership Card.

steps.text: Hop back down and walk through the open gate into the Haunted Wasteland.
steps.detail: There is no way back across the desert except by finishing it, so top up hearts and magic before you step through.

steps.text: Play the Sun's Song so it is daytime, then run forward and climb onto the wooden crate at the edge of the quicksand.
steps.detail: Daylight thins the sandstorm enough to make out the next landmark. The quicksand ahead swallows you and spits you back at the entrance.

steps.text: Longshot the crates on the far side of the quicksand to pull yourself across.
steps.detail: Target the stacked crates, not the sand. If you do fall in, you restart at the wasteland entrance with nothing lost but time.

steps.text: Walk to the first flag pole ahead and stop at its base.
steps.detail: The flags are the only safe route. Straying off the line drops you back at the start of the wasteland.

steps.text: With your back to that pole, pick the next flag out of the sandstorm and walk straight to it.
steps.detail: Each flag is placed just within sight of the one before it. If you cannot see the next one, walk back to the last flag and look again.

steps.text: Optional: at the flag with the wooden sign, follow the direction it points to the little dock and buy Bombchus from the carpet merchant.
steps.detail: The Hover Boots get you out over the sand and back. He wants 200 Rupees and you do not need what he is selling; the temple hands you Bombchus for free. Return to the sign afterwards.

steps.text: Back on the line of flags, keep moving from one flag to the next until a square stone building rises out of the sandstorm ahead of you.
steps.detail: Keep checking that a flag is behind you as well as ahead of you; that is how you know you are still on the route. The building is the only structure in the desert, so once it is in sight you cannot get lost.

steps.text: Jump down through the opening on top of the building into the chamber inside.
steps.detail: The sandstorm stops down here, which makes the next few steps much easier to see.

steps.text: Kill the Gold Skulltula hanging between the two torches at the back of the chamber and take its token.
steps.detail: An arrow or a slash both work; it is at head height.

steps.text: Light the torches down here with Din's Fire or a Fire Arrow for a 50 Rupee reward, then smash the jars.
steps.detail: Not worth the magic unless your wallet is light, but it is part of a clean sweep.

steps.text: Climb back out, walk up the ramp along the side of the building to its roof and switch on the Lens of Truth to reveal the lantern-carrying Poe who guides you the rest of the way.
steps.detail: A stone slab up here hints that you need the eye of truth. Go in with a full Magic Meter, or drink a Green Potion first: without the Lens he is invisible.

steps.text: Follow the Poe, staying right behind him and keeping the Lens of Truth switched on as he winds between the wooden poles.
steps.detail: If your magic runs out he disappears; walk back to the stone building, refill and summon him again from the roof.

steps.text: Stay with him to the end of the desert, where the sand gives way and the Desert Colossus opens up in front of you.
steps.detail: The Poe leaves once you reach solid ground.

steps.text: Cross the sand towards the giant goddess statue carved into the cliff, dodging the Leevers that spin up out of the ground.
steps.detail: Leevers keep coming as long as you stand on sand; keep moving and they mostly miss you.

steps.text: Climb the steps and enter the Spirit Temple, raising your shield straight away against the two jars that fly at you.
steps.detail: The jars hover on the pedestals by the door and launch themselves the moment you walk in.

steps.text: Go up the entry stairs and check the two dead ends: the crawl hole on the left is too small for you and the silver block on the right will not budge. Walk back outside.
steps.detail: The crawl hole is child-sized and the block needs the Silver Gauntlets, which is exactly the errand ahead of you.

steps.text: Outside, Sheik drops down from the ledge and teaches you the Requiem of Spirit.
steps.detail: It warps you straight to the Desert Colossus, which is the only way child Link can get here: the Gerudo will not let a child through the fortress.

steps.text: Go to the north side of the Colossus, near where you arrived, and bomb the cracked wall behind the two lone trees.
steps.detail: The crack is at the base of the cliff between the pair of palm trees standing on their own.

steps.text: Step into the Great Fairy Fountain, stand on the Triforce and play Zelda's Lullaby; the Great Fairy of Magic gives you Nayru's Love.
steps.detail: Nayru's Love wraps Link in a shield that blocks all damage for just under a minute. It is a lifesaver against the Iron Knuckles and Twinrova.

steps.text: Leave the fountain, walk to the dried-up oasis at the south end of the Colossus, climb onto the rock in its middle, play the Song of Storms and bottle the red fairies that appear over the water.
steps.detail: The rock keeps the Leevers off you while the water rises. The fairies keep respawning, so fill every empty bottle you own before going into the temple.

steps.text: Play the Sun's Song for night, then Longshot the Gold Skulltula near the top of one of the three palm trees by the oasis.
steps.detail: The trees stand in a trio at the south end of the map, right by the water you just filled.

steps.text: Play the Prelude of Light to warp to the Temple of Time, then put the Master Sword back in the pedestal to become a child again.
steps.detail: Walk into the inner chamber and press A at the pedestal. Everything in your adult inventory waits for you here.

steps.text: Play the Requiem of Spirit to warp back to the Desert Colossus as a child.
steps.detail: This is why Sheik gave you the song: there is no walking route here for child Link.

steps.text: Walk to the pair of boulders sticking out of the sand in the dead centre of the desert and lift the small rock between them.
steps.detail: The Leevers are as tall as you are now, so keep moving between them.

steps.text: Catch the bugs that scurry out from under the rock in an empty bottle.
steps.detail: Open the bottle right on top of them before they burrow back into the sand. Skip this if you already carry a bottle of bugs.

steps.text: Drop the bugs onto the patch of soft soil beside the Spirit Temple entrance and kill the Gold Skulltula that digs its way out.
steps.detail: The soil patch is on the flat ground just short of the temple steps.

steps.text: Plant a Magic Bean in the same patch of soft soil.
steps.detail: Buy the bean from the salesman by Zora's River if you do not have one. It will be a full-grown plant when you come back as an adult, and it carries you to two collectibles you cannot otherwise reach.

steps.text: Enter the Spirit Temple as a child.
steps.detail: The child half of the dungeon runs from here to the Silver Gauntlets.

steps.text: Raise your shield the moment you step in: two jars launch themselves at you from the pedestals ahead.
steps.detail: Keep the Hylian Shield equipped for this whole half of the dungeon. Fire Keese burn a Deku Shield off your back in one hit.

steps.text: Go up the stairs, past the Armos, and head left towards the crawl hole; a Gerudo woman is standing in the way.
steps.detail: This is Nabooru, Ganondorf's second in command, and she is not in the mood to arrest you.

steps.text: Talk to her, answer that you are not doing anything, agree to fetch the Silver Gauntlets, then crawl through the hole she unblocks.
steps.detail: The first answer has to be "I'm not doing anything" to move the conversation on; the second question does not matter. This is Nabooru, and you will not see her again until the end of the adult half.

steps.text: In the Main Corridor, shoot down the two Fire Keese and two Keese with the Fairy Slingshot, bomb the Armos, then take the left-hand door of the two that unlock.
steps.detail: Kill the fliers first so nothing is chasing you while you plant the bomb; the Boomerang stuns the Armos instead. Two spike traps slide along the floor here. The room points you at the right-hand door: ignore it, that is for later.

steps.text: Beat the Stalfos in the next room.
steps.detail: As a child your sword is short and slow, so strike once and back off. If you can bait his jump attack near the edge, he will drop into the pit on his own.

steps.text: Kill the big green Bubble: stun it with the Boomerang, then finish it with the Fairy Slingshot.
steps.detail: It circles the gap in the middle of the room and takes a couple of hits.

steps.text: Throw the Boomerang at the crystal switch on the far side of the gap, aiming well to the left so the curve wraps around onto it; the bridge drops.
steps.detail: The Boomerang will not fly straight there. Stand at the edge, aim off to the side and let its arc do the work.

steps.text: Cross the bridge, open the chest on the far side for a Deku Shield and go through the door beyond it.
steps.detail: Worth carrying the shield as a spare even if you keep the Hylian Shield equipped. The door leads to the first Anubis room.

steps.text: Lure the Anubis across the room so it hovers right beside the far door.
steps.detail: The Anubis copies your movement exactly, so walk to mirror it into position. It is immune to everything but fire, and it spits a fireball if you swing a weapon at it.

steps.text: Shoot the crystal switch on the right-hand wall with the Slingshot to light the flame by that door and burn the Anubis, then go through the door.
steps.detail: Din's Fire kills it instantly at close range if you have the magic to spare.

steps.text: In the next room, kill the lone Fire Keese on your side of the grating and then the Wallmaster before it drops on you.
steps.detail: Navi calls the Wallmaster out as you enter. Watch for its shadow spreading on the floor and step out of it.

steps.text: Climb the grating and take the Silver Rupees on it one at a time, then drop down and collect the ones sitting on the floor.
steps.detail: A Gold Skulltula clings to the grating and can sting you through the bars, so keep clear of it while you climb. There are five Silver Rupees in the room and the order does not matter.

steps.text: Take the last Silver Rupee, in the corner beside the lit torch; the gate drops into a bridge and Keese swarm in, so kill them one at a time.
steps.detail: If the gate does not move you have missed a rupee: sweep the grating again. Fight the Keese with your back to a wall and pick off the stragglers with the Slingshot.

steps.text: Throw the Boomerang at the Gold Skulltula on the grating and collect its token.
steps.detail: The Boomerang brings the token back to you without you having to touch the grating.

steps.text: Light a Deku Stick at the burning torch, run across the bridge and light both unlit torches before it burns out.
steps.detail: Din's Fire does both at once if you stand between them. A small chest appears back on the other side of the bridge.

steps.text: Cross back, open the small chest for a Small Key, then take the door out of this room back to the Main Corridor.
steps.detail: You come out beside the lone spike trap.

steps.text: In the Main Corridor, crawl through the small hole in the north wall and unlock the door in the little area beyond.
steps.detail: That spends your first Small Key.

steps.text: In the next room turn right, shoot the two Skullwalltulas off the climbable wall with the Slingshot and climb up.
steps.detail: Take them both out before you touch the wall or they knock you straight back down.

steps.text: At the top of the wall, turn around and look down behind you, then Boomerang the Gold Skulltula for its token.
steps.detail: It sits on the wall directly above where you started climbing, which is why it is easy to walk straight past.

steps.text: Walk around the room until the two Lizalfos appear, then kill them both.
steps.detail: They spawn when you step on certain spots. Fight them one at a time and block the tail swipes.

steps.text: Shoot the crystal switch above the tiered ledge on the south side with the Slingshot and open both small chests that appear; one holds Bombchus.
steps.detail: Skip this only if you already carry Bombchus, and even then the second chest is free loot.

steps.text: Line up on the cracked wall with sunlight leaking through it, send a Bombchu into it, then go through the door the sunlight opens.
steps.detail: The Bombchu drives along the floor into the crack. Blowing it open lets the sun reach the sun face set in the middle of the floor, which unlocks the door into the Colossus Room.

steps.text: Push the Armos statue by the entrance off the ledge so it lands on the floor switch below.
steps.detail: The switch has to stay held down, which is what the statue is for. It opens the door up above you.

steps.text: Climb the stairs and go through the door that opened, then follow the red stairs round and go through the next door.
steps.detail: That puts you in the Sun Face room with the raised platforms.

steps.text: Bomb the three Beamos in the Sun Face room, one at a time.
steps.detail: Only a bomb hurts a Beamos. Spike traps patrol between the platforms while you work, so plant and run.

steps.text: Climb the niche in the south wall where a Beamos was sitting and take the Silver Rupee there.
steps.detail: Every platform has a Beamos alcove you can use as a step up.

steps.text: Take the two Silver Rupees over the middle of the room, jumping across for the second one.
steps.detail: Line up the jump from the higher block; you land back on the sand if you miss, which costs nothing.

steps.text: Climb the north side and take the last two Silver Rupees; the golden torch lights up.
steps.detail: If the torch stays dark you are still one rupee short somewhere.

steps.text: Light the rest of the torches from the golden one, working clockwise around the room, then climb up to the small chest that appears and take the Small Key.
steps.detail: A Deku Stick lit at the golden torch reaches the next one comfortably if you do not want to burn magic on Din's Fire.

steps.text: Pull the blocks in the centre of the room out of your way, push the one carrying the Sun Face into the shaft of sunlight, then go through the door that opens across the room.
steps.detail: Shift the blocks you do not need aside first, then line the Sun Face block up under the beam coming through the ceiling. Beyond the door is a narrow corridor with a set of stairs.

steps.text: Turn around and look above the door you just came through: Boomerang the Gold Skulltula there and take its token.
steps.detail: Easy to miss because the corridor pushes you straight up the stairs.

steps.text: Go up the stairs and through the next door, then hit the armoured statue on the throne with any weapon to wake the Iron Knuckle.
steps.detail: This is the hardest fight you have as a child; go in with full hearts and a fairy in a bottle.

steps.text: Beat the Iron Knuckle.
steps.detail: Wait for him to swing the axe, back off, then dart in and stab while he is recovering, and immediately retreat. Luring him into a pillar or the throne smashes it open for three recovery hearts. Nayru's Love or Bombchus from range make it much safer.

steps.text: Go through the door that opens behind the throne into the sunlight, hear Kaepora Gaebora out, then open the chest for the Silver Gauntlets.
steps.detail: You are standing on the statue's right hand. As soon as the chest opens, a scene shows the Twinrova sisters carrying Nabooru off. The Silver Gauntlets let adult Link shift the silver blocks.

steps.text: Play the Prelude of Light to warp to the Temple of Time and pull the Master Sword to become an adult again.
steps.detail: There is nothing left for child Link in this chapter.

steps.text: Play the Requiem of Spirit to warp back to the Desert Colossus.
steps.detail: You land on the platform in front of the temple, right beside the soft soil.

steps.text: Play the Sun's Song for night, then step onto the leaf of the fully grown Magic Bean plant by the temple entrance and ride it to the big rock at the north end of the desert.
steps.detail: Hop off when the leaf settles on top of the rock. If you miss the landing, walk back to the plant and ride again.

steps.text: Kill the Gold Skulltula waiting on top of that rock and take its token.
steps.detail: It is only there at night, which is why you played the Sun's Song first.

steps.text: Ride the bean plant again and, as the leaf passes underneath the stone arch near the temple entrance, jump off onto the arch and take the Piece of Heart.
steps.detail: The leaf loops the whole desert and dips under the arch on the way back. Jump the instant it starts climbing again or you will overshoot.

steps.text: Enter the temple, shield against the flying jars, go up the entry stairs and push the giant silver block on the right until it drops into the hole.
steps.detail: The Silver Gauntlets make the block movable and open up the far half of the entry room. A Beamos and a spike trap live back there; both can simply be walked around.

steps.text: Shoot the crystal switch hanging from the ceiling in the middle of the room with the Longshot or an arrow; both doors unlock.
steps.detail: Look straight up from the centre of the new section to find it.

steps.text: Take the left-hand door, kill the Wolfos that jumps out, then stand on the Triforce symbol on the floor and play Zelda's Lullaby; a large chest appears across the room.
steps.detail: Z-target the Wolfos, sidestep its swipe and cut it down, or slice its tail as it circles. The Triforce symbol is on the raised part of the floor near the entrance.

steps.text: Longshot across to the chest and open it for the Compass, then drop into the sand, climb out and take the opposite door on the right side of the entry room.
steps.detail: If you land in the sandy pit on the way over, climb the slope and try the Longshot again. The right-hand door leads to the rolling boulder room.

steps.text: Collect the four Silver Rupees tucked in the cubby holes around the rolling boulder room, two on each side.
steps.detail: Three boulders run laps of this bowl-shaped room. Duck into a cubby as one passes and move on behind it.

steps.text: Climb up and use the Hover Boots to reach the fifth Silver Rupee floating over the middle of the room; the door across the way opens.
steps.detail: Start from the raised lip, walk out and grab it before the boots run out. If you drop, climb back up and try again.

steps.text: Before you leave, stand in front of the Time Block and play the Song of Time to remove it, then take the Gold Skulltula token in the alcove behind it.
steps.detail: Navi turns green in front of the block. Play the song again afterwards if you want the block back.

steps.text: Go through the opened door, kill the Like Like that drops from the ceiling and open the small chest for a Small Key.
steps.detail: Kill the Like Like fast: it swallows you and can eat your shield and tunic. The chest is the only other thing in the room.

steps.text: Backtrack two rooms to the section with the Beamos and spike trap and open the locked door with the Small Key.
steps.detail: It is the door in the half of the entry room you revealed by pushing the silver block.

steps.text: In the trap room, kill the Like Like that drops and the two jars that attack from the right, then climb the grooved wall at the far end.
steps.detail: Take the jars out from a distance with arrows if they crowd you.

steps.text: Switch on the Lens of Truth to find the invisible Floormaster, kill it, then charge a spin attack to wipe out the three small ones it splits into.
steps.detail: You can hear it moving before you see it. If the little ones latch on they merge back into a full Floormaster.

steps.text: Grab the mirror and push it along its track to light the first Sun Face for a chest, then push it on to the second Sun Face for a second chest.
steps.detail: Pull and push the mirror with A. The second chest is a trap: opening it freezes Link solid for a few seconds. Skip it if you like, but a complete chest count wants it opened.

steps.text: Push the mirror on to the third Sun Face to unlock the door, then go through it into the Colossus Room.
steps.detail: Do not push it as far as the fourth Sun Face: that spawns a Wallmaster.

steps.text: Cross to the statue's nearer left hand with the Hover Boots, play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol to make two chests appear, then Longshot to the other hand and open the small chest for a Small Key.
steps.detail: Keep clear of the Armos in this room, it comes alive. If you fall to the floor below there is a Longshot target above the entrance to get you back up.

steps.text: Longshot back up to the top of the west side, play the Scarecrow's Song where Navi turns green in the northwest corner, then Longshot to Pierre and take the Gold Skulltula token.
steps.detail: You must have taught Bonooru the Scarecrow's Song at Lake Hylia as a child; without it this token is out of reach.

steps.text: Drop to the middle of the room, light both torches with Din's Fire or Fire Arrows and open the large chest that appears for the Dungeon Map.
steps.detail: The torches stand either side of the central floor, below the statue.

steps.text: Go back up to the southeast corner, Longshot across the gap to the small chest that has appeared there, then smash the rusty switch beside it with the Megaton Hammer.
steps.detail: The chest only exists because you played Zelda's Lullaby on the hand earlier. The hammer blow opens the barred door in the middle of the room.

steps.text: Drop down, go through the unbarred door, push the giant silver blocks into the holes and smash the rusty switch at the end with the Megaton Hammer to start the elevator.
steps.detail: The elevator runs up to the dungeon entrance, so from now on you can drop into the temple and ride straight back down to this level.

steps.text: Go back to the Colossus Room, climb to its southeast corner, open the locked door with the Small Key and take the stairs beyond, running past or bombing the lone Beamos.
steps.detail: Longshot targets and the stairs on the east side get you back up to the top of the room.

steps.text: In the second Anubis room, bomb the Beamos by the entrance, then walk to the pit on the right where Navi turns green and play the Song of Time to raise a Time Block.
steps.detail: Three Anubis share this room. Din's Fire or Fire Arrows kill them outright if your magic is full; the block is for the slower, cheaper method.

steps.text: Hit the switch to light the fire in the middle, then walk the outside wall clockwise; all three Anubis follow you into the flame. Go through the door that opens.
steps.detail: They copy your movement, so a slow lap of the wall drags each one across the fire in turn. Standing on the Time Block and by each door does the same job one at a time.

steps.text: In the Armos room, stand beside the barred door on the right, shoot an Armos on the far side to lure it onto the middle switch, run through while the door is open, then use the Lens of Truth in the hallway to find and open two hidden chests.
steps.detail: The switch only stays down while something heavy sits on it, so be in position before you wake the Armos. The two chests are invisible without the Lens.

steps.text: Go up the stairs and beat the second Iron Knuckle.
steps.detail: Much easier as an adult: bait the axe swing, step in, and hit him with the Biggoron's Sword or a jump attack. He still smashes the pillars for recovery hearts.

steps.text: Step through the door that opens behind the throne into the sunlight and open the large chest that thumps down for the Mirror Shield.
steps.detail: You are on the statue's left hand. Remember the Mirror Shield does not deflect ordinary projectiles the way the Hylian Shield does, so keep swapping as needed.

steps.text: Go back to the Armos room, equip the Mirror Shield, reflect the sunlight onto the Sun Face above the door on the opposite side, then go in and take the Small Key from the chest.
steps.detail: Stand in the beam, hold up the shield and turn until the reflected spot lands on the face. No trap on this chest, despite how it looks.

steps.text: Return to the second Anubis room, open the locked door with the Small Key, then bomb the two Beamos in the shaft beyond and shoot the Skullwalltula off the wall.
steps.detail: Clear them before you start climbing or they knock you back down into the pit.

steps.text: Longshot straight up to the top of the shaft, past the sliding walls, and go through the door up there.
steps.detail: Climbing is possible but fiddly: hang just under a moving section, wait until it slides towards you, then hold up and run for the next ledge. Two more Beamos wait at the top; a Longshot to the side platform reaches some recovery hearts.

steps.text: In the little corridor, play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol on the floor to open the barred door ahead.
steps.detail: The plain door on the right is the way to the boss; leave it until you have the Boss Key.

steps.text: Kill all the Fire Slugs in the boss key room, then bomb the fake door immediately left of the flaming chest to reveal a gold eye switch and shoot it with an arrow.
steps.detail: The Fire Slugs ooze along the floor and burn on contact; arrows or a couple of sword swings each. Shooting the eye makes a second icy platform appear above the first.

steps.text: Longshot up to the first platform, jump to the second, stand on the switch to kill the flames, then drop down and open the ornate chest for the Boss Key.
steps.detail: The flames only stay down a few seconds, so go straight from the switch to the chest. If they come back, climb up and hit the switch again.

steps.text: Go back to the Triforce corridor, take the plain door on the right, shield against the flying jars and hit the crystal switch beyond the bars with an arrow or the Longshot.
steps.detail: On the N64 version the switch sits behind the bars, but you can still hit it from where you stand. The door it opens is the way to the boss.

steps.text: Go through and kill the Lizalfos, then use the Mirror Shield to throw the sunlight onto the Sun Face above the next arch and open the small chest that appears for Bombs.
steps.detail: Block the Lizalfos lunges and counter. For the Sun Face, stand in the beam, face the arch and angle the shield up.

steps.text: In the next area, kill all the White Bubbles.
steps.detail: They bounce around unpredictably, so arrows are safer than the sword.

steps.text: Bomb the odd-looking wall on the west side to open up the dark room your map says should be there.
steps.detail: Compare the room shapes on your Dungeon Map if you cannot spot which wall it is.

steps.text: Turn the first mirror so the beam shines through the new opening into the dark room, then turn the second so the light passes through the bars onto the round mirror at the end.
steps.detail: The mirrors rotate in place with A. Check the beam is actually landing on the round mirror before you leave the room.

steps.text: Go back out the door, drop into the lower area and shield against the killer jars down there.
steps.detail: The light you just routed is now bouncing off the mirror above your head.

steps.text: Catch that light on your Mirror Shield and aim it at the Sun Face on the wall; the platform you are on lowers into the Colossus Room.
steps.detail: Stand where the reflected beam hits you, then turn to put the bright spot on the face.

steps.text: Down in the Colossus Room, reflect the light onto the head of the giant statue to shatter it.
steps.detail: Hold the Mirror Shield up and aim high; the whole head crumbles in a scene.

steps.text: Longshot the bars across the gap to pull them aside, then open the boss door with the Boss Key.
steps.detail: Top up hearts and magic here: bottled fairies, a Green Potion and Nayru's Love all pay for themselves in the next two fights.

steps.text: Beat the third Iron Knuckle that Koume and Kotake send at you; the armour falls away to reveal a brainwashed Nabooru, who is then snatched away again.
steps.detail: This one hits harder and moves faster than the last two. Same rhythm: bait the swing, step in, strike, retreat. Nayru's Love makes it almost free.

steps.text: Go through the final door and climb any of the corner ramps into the big open boss room, then stand on the middle platform to start the fight.
steps.detail: Nothing happens until you step onto the centre platform, so get your Mirror Shield equipped first.

steps.text: Phase one: catch each sister's beam on the Mirror Shield and bounce it at the other sister.
steps.detail: Koume shoots fire, Kotake ice. Wait on the opposite side of the room, face whoever is charging, then either hold R or switch targets to the other sister as the beam arrives. Each beam leaves a patch on the ground that burns or freezes you; keep moving and roll if you catch fire.

steps.text: Phase two: they merge into Twinrova. Block three beams of the same element, aim the charged shield at her to knock her down, then jump onto her platform and slash her until she rises. Repeat until she falls.
steps.detail: Absorb only one element: dodge the other kind or the shield discharges into you. After three of a kind the shield glows; point it at her from close range. A jump attack on the way over adds damage. Three or four knockdowns finish her.

steps.text: Take the Heart Container the sisters leave behind, then step onto the blue portal.
steps.detail: The portal sits in the middle of the arena floor.

steps.text: Listen to Nabooru, the Sage of Spirit, and accept the Spirit Medallion.
steps.detail: That is the sixth and last medallion. You are dropped back at the Desert Colossus warp pad afterwards, with only Ganon's Castle left.

steps.text: Cross the Haunted Wasteland east from the Desert Colossus and go through the gate back into Gerudo's Fortress.
steps.detail: Follow the flag poles back the way you came and cross the river of sand on the plank bridge. If you are somewhere else in Hyrule, ride Epona from Hyrule Field through Gerudo Valley instead.

steps.text: Before going in, top up: a full quiver of arrows, a few bombs, a bottled fairy, and a full Magic Meter for the Lens of Truth.
steps.detail: This whole place leans on the Longshot, the Lens of Truth, the Hover Boots, the Megaton Hammer, the Silver Gauntlets, the Fairy Bow, the Iron Boots and the Zora Tunic. There is no fairy fountain inside, but the lobby has a Song of Storms fairy spot.

steps.text: Walk to the barred doorway at the front of the fortress grounds, talk to the Gerudo in white standing in front of it, and show the Gerudo Membership Card to be let in.
steps.detail: The card is what gets you in, but keep a few rupees on you just in case. You need every carpenter rescued before she will even talk to you.

steps.text: In the lobby, turn around and shoot the gold eye switch on the wall above the door you came in through.
steps.detail: Back up a couple of steps first so the switch is in view, then aim in first person with C-up. Two small chests drop into the room.

steps.text: Open one of the two chests that appeared for a Blue Rupee.
Open the other chest for a bundle of Arrows.
Take the door on the left side of the lobby into the sandy Stalfos room.
steps.detail: The lobby has three doors. The two side doors start a loop that comes back here; the door straight across from the entrance leads to the locked doors and the Ice Arrows, so save that one for last.

steps.text: Kill both Stalfos before the one-minute timer runs out.
steps.detail: Keep moving so the sand does not bog you down. Z-target one at a time, block the overhead swing and counter; the Biggoron's Sword drops each in a few hits. If the timer expires, step back out the door and come in again to reset the challenge.

steps.text: Open the chest that appears for a Small Key (1 of 9).
steps.detail: Nothing in this outer loop is locked. Every Small Key you find goes to the ring of locked doors in the middle of the dungeon, which you tackle at the end.

steps.text: Go through the door on the far side of the Stalfos room into the rolling-boulder maze.
Run forward, turn left down the corridor, and wait at the corner until the rolling boulder passes.
steps.detail: A one minute thirty timer starts the moment you enter, and five Silver Rupees are hidden in the corridors. A Wallmaster patrols the middle; ignore it and keep moving. Fail the timer and you reset the room by leaving through the door you came in and re-entering.

steps.text: Turn left behind the boulder and grab the first Silver Rupee.
Head right up the corridor, ducking into the side crevices whenever the boulder comes at you, and take the second Silver Rupee at the top.
steps.detail: The crevices are the only safe spots in this stretch. Wait in one until the boulder rolls past, then sprint to the next.

steps.text: Move over to the raised middle corridor, the one with no flames in it, and turn right.
Jump off the ledge at the end of the middle corridor to land on the third Silver Rupee.
Go back into the middle corridor and along its right side, wait out the boulder once more, then round the corner clockwise for the fourth Silver Rupee.
Longshot the target on the ceiling straight ahead and drop onto the fifth Silver Rupee. The timer stops and the door unbars.
Work your way up to the door, dodging the flames that flare out of the walls, then Longshot the ceiling target by the door and go through it.
steps.detail: The flames are invisible until they burst, and they block the last stretch on foot. The Longshot pull carries you over them.

steps.text: Kill the two Wolfos and two White Wolfos that drop into the hall of fake doors.
steps.detail: White Wolfos block attacks from the front. Z-target, backflip so one lunges past you, then slash its exposed side. Din's Fire thins the pack in one go if your magic is full.

steps.text: Hold up the Lens of Truth and face the fake door: a hidden ledge with a Longshot target appears above it.
Longshot the target on the hidden ledge above the fake door.
steps.detail: Keep the Lens on while you aim, or the target vanishes before you fire.

steps.text: Step on the floor switch up on the ledge; the barred doors down in the room below open.
Jump back down and push the giant silver block with the Silver Gauntlets until it drops into the hole in the floor.
steps.detail: Walk into it and hold A to shove. Without the Silver Gauntlets from the Spirit Temple, Link cannot move it at all.

steps.text: Take the door the silver block was blocking, into the small Like Like room.
Kill the three Like Likes; two extra chests appear when the last one dies.
steps.detail: Shoot them with arrows or the Longshot from across the room so they cannot swallow your shield or tunic. If one does eat your gear, killing it drops the gear back on the floor.

steps.text: Open one of the two new chests at the front of the room for a Blue Rupee.
Open the other new chest for a Gold Rupee worth 200 rupees.
steps.detail: You need the Giant's Wallet to hold the whole thing; with the Adult's Wallet it just tops you out at 200.

steps.text: Leave the chest on the raised platform in the middle alone: it is a trap that freezes Link solid.
steps.detail: There is nothing in it. If you open it anyway, mash buttons to shake the ice off and eat the damage.

steps.text: Hold up the Lens of Truth over the last sandy pit in the room to reveal an invisible chest sitting in it.
Drop into the pit and open the invisible chest for a Small Key (2 of 9).
Go back through the door into the hall of fake doors.
Longshot the target on the hidden ledge again and take the door up there into the eye statue room.
steps.detail: Use the Lens of Truth once more if the target is not showing.

steps.text: Stand on the upper walkway facing the barred door and play the Scarecrow's Song while Navi is green to plant Pierre there.
steps.detail: Optional, but it gives you an easy Longshot target to get back up here. Skip it if you never learned the Scarecrow's Song: jumping into the lava below also puts Link back on this ledge, just for a little damage.

steps.text: Jump down into the pit onto the outer ring platform, which starts spinning the moment you land.
Face the statue on the island in the middle and shoot one of its eyes with an arrow.
steps.detail: Aim in first person with C-up and fire as the spin swings you into line. A missed arrow costs nothing but the arrow.

steps.text: Shoot the statue's other eye; a small chest appears on the island beside it.
Longshot across to the island and open the chest for a Small Key (3 of 9).
Longshot the target near where you dropped into the pit to pull yourself back out.
Get back up to the upper walkway: Longshot Pierre, or jump into the lava and let it drop you back on the ledge.
steps.detail: The lava costs a little health but always works. Either way, the door up there is no longer barred.

steps.text: Go through the door on the upper walkway that was barred before.
Open the chest inside for a Small Key (4 of 9).
steps.detail: If the room looks empty, hold up the Lens of Truth.

steps.text: Come back out, drop down to the bottom of the statue room, and take the other door out of it into the flame room.
Kill the two Fire Keese and the Torch Slugs; the far door opens and a chest appears.
steps.detail: Pick the Fire Keese off with arrows or the Longshot before they reach you, and hit the Torch Slugs from behind when their flame dips.

steps.text: Open the chest that appeared; the contents are minor.
steps.detail: Nothing in it matters. The prize in this room is the key sitting inside the ring of fire in the middle.

steps.text: Smash the statues dotted around the room with the Megaton Hammer for the rupees and hearts hidden under them.
Smash the statue in the northeast corner with the Megaton Hammer to uncover a floor switch sunk in a hole.
steps.detail: Northeast is the far right corner as you came in. This is the only statue that hides a switch.

steps.text: Step on the switch, then sprint straight to the chest in the middle of the room and open it for a Small Key (5 of 9) before the fire comes back.
steps.detail: You get only a few seconds. Line yourself up with the chest before you press the switch, and do not wear the Hover Boots: they slide you past it.

steps.text: Take the next door out of the flame room into the lava room.
steps.detail: If you ever want to come back through here the other way, shoot the gold eye switch in this room to reopen the door to the statue room.

steps.text: Step forward a little, turn around, and Longshot the ceiling target directly above the doorway to snag the first Silver Rupee.
steps.detail: Five Silver Rupees in this room open the east door.

steps.text: Drop down onto the platform in front of you and take the second Silver Rupee on it.
Equip the Hover Boots and float across to the middle platform.
steps.detail: The boots glide for about a second, so leave the edge at a run and do not stop halfway.

steps.text: Face the spot straight ahead where Navi turns green and play the Song of Time; two Time Blocks appear over the lava.
Float over to the Time Blocks and climb all the way to the top of them.
Pick up the Small Key lying loose on top (6 of 9).
steps.detail: It is a freestanding key, not a chest. Do not take the door up here: it drops you into the locked maze from the wrong end, where you would need nine keys instead of seven.

steps.text: Drop off the side of the platform onto the ledge with the lone floor switch and step on it; the flames on the platforms across the room go out.
With the Hover Boots still on, float along the line of platforms and collect the third Silver Rupee.
Keep going to the far side of the room and grab the fourth Silver Rupee there.
Run back to the middle of the room and take the fifth Silver Rupee last; the east door opens.
steps.detail: Save the middle one for last on purpose. If you finish on an outer platform, the lava can return during the door-opening cutscene and knock Link in, restarting the whole room.

steps.text: Go through the east door into the water room.
Play the Song of Time to remove the Time Blocks in your way.
Put on the Zora Tunic and the Iron Boots and sink to the floor of the room.
steps.detail: The Zora Tunic is what lets you breathe down here; without it you will be surfacing for air every few seconds.

steps.text: Kill the four Shell Blades with the Longshot, keeping clear of the Blade Trap spinning in the middle of the floor.
steps.detail: Shell Blades snap shut on anything that swims close, so never melee them. Two Longshot hits each is usually enough.

steps.text: Walk a circle around the Blade Trap in the middle of the floor and pick up the first Silver Rupee.
steps.detail: Five Silver Rupees down here. Stay just outside the trap's swing and it never touches you.

steps.text: On the west wall, line up so the second Silver Rupee sits between you and the Longshot target, then fire: you grab it in flight and land on the third Silver Rupee.
steps.detail: If you overshoot the third one, just walk back and step on it.

steps.text: Do the same on the east wall: line up with that target through the fourth Silver Rupee and fire the Longshot.
Take off the Iron Boots and float up to the ceiling of the room for the fifth Silver Rupee.
Collecting all five rupees opens the way on: take the key or the opened door the room gives you and head back out.
steps.detail: The source guide skips this room's reward, so confirm in game what the five rupees produce here, then flag this step if it is wrong. Iron Boots make the swim back down easier.

steps.text: Take off the Iron Boots, swim up, and go back through the door into the lava room.
